title: Content Quality Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Content Editors to review and maintain legal documents and related records. You will help ensure that content is accurate, complete, consistently formatted, and processed within publication deadlines. This role combines editing, data entry, quality assurance, and coordination.



Key Responsibilities

- Review and edit legal documents, checking citations, case names, docket numbers, and other essential details for accuracy and consistency.

- Enter, organize, and update legal information in online and offline databases.

- Conduct quality checks to identify errors, missing information, and formatting inconsistencies.

- Track incoming documents and publication timelines to support timely processing.

- Maintain accurate progress records, manage task priorities, and prepare processing reports.

- Communicate with internal teams, clients, and external contacts to clarify document requirements and address delays or concerns.

- Use content management platforms, ticketing systems, and tracking tools to document and resolve content issues.

- Meet productivity goals and deadlines while maintaining established quality standards.



Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in any field; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.

- Good analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills.

- Basic computer proficiency, including familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.

- Ability to organize tasks, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.

- Willingness to learn new tools, systems, and procedures.

- Availability to work either the Morning Shift (6:00 AM–2:00 PM) or Mid Shift (2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT US



Vicky Rahmic Weddings & Events is an Australian luxury wedding, event and travel company servicing clients throughout Australia and internationally. We are growing our team and seeking an experienced, proactive Executive Assistant to work directly alongside our Founder and Creative Director.



This position is starting with 12 hours per week Tuesday to Friday has the potential to grow to 30–40 hours per week and progress into an Operations Manager and team leadership role.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Manage the Founder's inbox, calendar and appointments.

- Prepare daily briefings and weekly business reports.

- Manage tasks, deadlines and business priorities.

- Monitor enquiries and follow up with clients and suppliers.

- Assist with client onboarding and event administration.

- Maintain accurate records and digital filing systems.

- Create and maintain SOPs.

- Support business growth and operational improvements.

- Anticipate the Founder's needs without constant direction.



REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum three years of Executive Assistant or corporate operations experience.

- Events experience preferred 

- Previous experience supporting a CEO, Founder or Managing Director.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Strong organisational and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative and take ownership.

- Experience with Google Workspace and project management software.

- Reliable internet and computer equipment.

- Verifiable professional references.



Our systems include Google Workspace, Trello, TTO, Clockify. Training will be provided on industry-specific software. Significant experience with Google Workspace and Trello a must. 



WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



Our office operates Tuesday to Friday and is closed on Mondays. Working hours will be during Perth business hours 9am - 12noon



All additional hours must be approved in advance.



Performance and working hours will be reviewed after three months, with opportunities for increased hours and career progression based on performance and business growth.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, not simply complete assigned tasks.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use the following subject line:



Ordinary Isn't in Our Vocabulary | EA | Your Full Name



Your application must include:

1. Your updated CV.

2. A brief introduction outlining your executive support experience.

3. Your expected hourly rate in AUD.

4. Your current employment and other client commitments.

5. Your availability to increase your hours in the future.

6. Two professional references.



APPLICATION TASK

You begin your three-hour shift and discover the following:

- The Founder has an important meeting in two hours that is missing from her calendar.

- A new client enquiry has been unanswered since yesterday.

- A supplier invoice is due today.

- Five administrative tasks remain outstanding.

- The Founder is unavailable for the next hour.

In no more than 150 words, explain how you would prioritise these tasks and what actions you would take independently.



Finally, end your application by confirming which day of the week our office is closed.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and a paid practical assessment.



Vicky Rahmic Weddings & Events





Ordinary isn't in our vocabulary.

title: Senior ComfyUI & RunPod AI Video Specialist - Hyperrealistic AI Characters
description:
# Hiring: Senior ComfyUI & RunPod AI Video Specialist — Hyperrealistic AI Characters



**Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time (Potential Long-Term Opportunity)



**Project Overview**



We are building an automated AI video production studio that generates highly realistic, vertical talking-head videos featuring consistent virtual personalities.



Our existing system runs on RunPod and uses ComfyUI, InfiniteTalk, Python, ElevenLabs, and FFmpeg.



We are looking for an experienced specialist who can significantly improve the photorealism, motion quality, and consistency of our AI-generated characters.



**The system is already built and operational. We are not looking for someone to rebuild it from scratch.**



### Your Responsibilities



- Create exceptionally realistic AI-generated human characters.

- Improve skin texture, facial details, eyes, hair, and natural imperfections.

- Develop and optimize ComfyUI workflows on RunPod.

- Improve talking-head animation, lip-sync, and natural facial expressions.

- Reduce artificial-looking movements and visual distortions.

- Maintain consistent character identity across multiple generations.

- Optimize image-to-video settings for high-quality vertical videos.

- Create reusable avatar and environment presets.

- Troubleshoot artifacts and workflow performance issues.



### Required Experience



- Advanced experience with ComfyUI.

- Experience running AI-generation workflows on RunPod.

- Strong knowledge of AI image and video generation.

- Experience with realistic talking-head avatars and lip-sync.

- Familiarity with InfiniteTalk or comparable video-generation systems.

- Experience with reference-image consistency and character preservation.

- Ability to work with existing Python workflows.



### Ideal Candidate



You have produced AI-generated people who look convincingly real, not just beautiful AI portraits.



You understand the difference between producing an impressive still image and maintaining a believable human appearance throughout a full talking video.



### Paid Trial Project



We will begin with a paid technical test.



You will receive access to a limited copy of our existing workflow and be asked to:



1. Create one original, hyperrealistic character suitable for talking-head video.

2. Build an approved starting image with a believable environment.

3. Generate a short talking-head video using our existing system.

4. Demonstrate realistic facial movement, skin texture, and stable character identity.

5. Document your workflow and the settings required to reproduce the result.



### Application Requirements



Please send:



- Your three best examples of realistic AI human videos.

- Screenshots of ComfyUI workflows you've personally developed.

- Details of your RunPod experience.

- The AI models and techniques you currently use.

- Your hourly or fixed-project rate.

- A brief explanation of how you'd improve realism in a ComfyUI/InfiniteTalk pipeline.



**Important:** Applications without examples of actual AI-generated talking videos will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who can deliver measurable improvements and potentially collaborate long-term as we scale production.

title: EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager
description:
EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager

Protect the Founder’s Time. Let Founder do what they're best at.

Remote, Philippines | U.S. Eastern overlap | Full-time

50 hours per week



Compensation and Validation

$2,500/month during the first 90-day validation period

First 14 days are a paid work trial using real work

Operators who far exceed the agreed performance standard move to a $3,500/month base on Day 90, with additional upside as impact and ownership expand. 

Performance is reviewed weekly. Compensation and scope are formally reviewed at Day 90

This is not pay for activity.



You do not earn more by being online, maintaining a task list, or sending pleasant updates. You earn more by finishing meaningful work, protecting CEO's time, solving problems without being chased, and permanently removing work from his plate.



The Day 90 review will consider:

Meaningful work completed

Founder time and attention saved

Recurring responsibilities removed from CEO

Follow-ups eliminated

Blockers solved without founder intervention

Health, personal, and CEO priorities moved forward

Problems converted into delegation, automation, systems, or deletion

Whether CEO had to chase, remind, or re-explain work

If you exceed the agreed standard, your base increases to $3,500/month beginning with the next pay period. Exceptional performance can earn additional upside and expanded ownership.

There will be no surprise standards introduced at Day 90.



This role is for a rare kind of person

You see unfinished work and feel compelled to finish it.

You do not need a founder to explain every obvious next step.

You get genuine satisfaction from taking chaos, pressure, loose ends, and half-formed ideas and turning them into:

“Done. Here’s what changed.”

You are not looking for a job where you wait for instructions and keep a task list updated.

You want to become the person who makes an overloaded founder dramatically lighter.



Why this role exists

Ceo is a visionary.

His highest-value work is thinking, creating, d
, leading, and building the future.

His weakness is that once ideas leave his head, a mountain of execution follows:

Health tasks

Appointments

Records

Research

Follow-ups

Travel

Personal logistics

Errands

Vendors

Scheduling

Projects

Loose ends

When those things remain unfinished, they return to Dylan’s brain. He becomes the reminder system, scheduler, researcher, project manager, and emergency backup.

That steals his time, energy, health, focus, and ability to be fully himself.

Your job is to remove that burden.

Not organize it.

Not report on it.

Finish it.

Your mission

You are the execution engine behind Ceo’s vision.

You will take messy voice notes, ideas, priorities, and unfinished work and turn them into completed outcomes without requiring Ceo to project-manage the middle.



You will:

Clarify the desired outcome.

Identify the next actions.

Own or coordinate the execution.

Push through blockers.

Close the loop with proof.

Prevent the same problem from returning.

Your goal is for Ceo to spend more of his life being authentic by doing only what he should do. 

Thinking

Creating

D

Leading

Building the future

You handle the mountain of execution that allows him to stay in that role.



What you will own

Finish a large volume of meaningful work from Ceo’s active to-do list every day

Protect his calendar, deep work, recovery, health, and personal priorities

Drive health administration from approved decision to completion

Schedule appointments, gather records, prepare documents, and close follow-ups

Turn voice notes and ideas into prioritized action and completed projects

Own travel, Trip preparation, errands, purchases, vendors, reservations, and personal logistics

Chase people, enforce deadlines, remove blockers, and find another route when the first route fails

Keep open loops visible and moving

Identify recurring friction and eliminate it through delegation, automation, systemization, or deletion

Give concise updates containing what finished, what changed, what is blocked, your recommendation, and the next date

Protect team from being diverted into Ceo's personal and CEO-level execution work

You do not make medical, relationship, values, or major financial decisions. You own the execution around those decisions and escalate only what truly requires the CEO.

Health-related information must be handled only through approved, privacy-compliant systems and workflows.



What a great day looks like

At the beginning of the day, you know:

What CEO wants moved

What matters most

What can be handled without him

What needs clarification

What must be finished today

During the day, you move mountains:

Close open loops

Push delayed people

Complete health and personal tasks

Convert ideas into action

Remove friction

Protect CEOs time

Solve problems before they reach him

At the end of the day, CEO should not be asking, “What happened with that?”

He should be able to see:

What finished. What changed. What is blocked. What you are handling next.



What winning looks like

After 7 days

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.

title: EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager
description:
EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager

Protect the Founder’s Time. Let Founder do what they're best at.

Remote, Philippines | U.S. Eastern overlap | Full-time

50 hours per week



Compensation and Validation

$2,500/month during the first 90-day validation period

First 14 days are a paid work trial using real work

Operators who far exceed the agreed performance standard move to a $3,500/month base on Day 90, with additional upside as impact and ownership expand. 

Performance is reviewed weekly. Compensation and scope are formally reviewed at Day 90

This is not pay for activity.



You do not earn more by being online, maintaining a task list, or sending pleasant updates. You earn more by finishing meaningful work, protecting CEO's time, solving problems without being chased, and permanently removing work from his plate.



The Day 90 review will consider:

Meaningful work completed

Founder time and attention saved

Recurring responsibilities removed from CEO

Follow-ups eliminated

Blockers solved without founder intervention

Health, personal, and CEO priorities moved forward

Problems converted into delegation, automation, systems, or deletion

Whether CEO had to chase, remind, or re-explain work

If you exceed the agreed standard, your base increases to $3,500/month beginning with the next pay period. Exceptional performance can earn additional upside and expanded ownership.

There will be no surprise standards introduced at Day 90.



This role is for a rare kind of person

You see unfinished work and feel compelled to finish it.

You do not need a founder to explain every obvious next step.

You get genuine satisfaction from taking chaos, pressure, loose ends, and half-formed ideas and turning them into:

“Done. Here’s what changed.”

You are not looking for a job where you wait for instructions and keep a task list updated.

You want to become the person who makes an overloaded founder dramatically lighter.



Why this role exists

Ceo is a visionary.

His highest-value work is thinking, creating, d
, leading, and building the future.

His weakness is that once ideas leave his head, a mountain of execution follows:

Health tasks

Appointments

Records

Research

Follow-ups

Travel

Personal logistics

Errands

Vendors

Scheduling

Projects

Loose ends

When those things remain unfinished, they return to Dylan’s brain. He becomes the reminder system, scheduler, researcher, project manager, and emergency backup.

That steals his time, energy, health, focus, and ability to be fully himself.

Your job is to remove that burden.

Not organize it.

Not report on it.

Finish it.

Your mission

You are the execution engine behind Ceo’s vision.

You will take messy voice notes, ideas, priorities, and unfinished work and turn them into completed outcomes without requiring Ceo to project-manage the middle.



You will:

Clarify the desired outcome.

Identify the next actions.

Own or coordinate the execution.

Push through blockers.

Close the loop with proof.

Prevent the same problem from returning.

Your goal is for Ceo to spend more of his life being authentic by doing only what he should do. 

Thinking

Creating

D

Leading

Building the future

You handle the mountain of execution that allows him to stay in that role.



What you will own

Finish a large volume of meaningful work from Ceo’s active to-do list every day

Protect his calendar, deep work, recovery, health, and personal priorities

Drive health administration from approved decision to completion

Schedule appointments, gather records, prepare documents, and close follow-ups

Turn voice notes and ideas into prioritized action and completed projects

Own travel, Trip preparation, errands, purchases, vendors, reservations, and personal logistics

Chase people, enforce deadlines, remove blockers, and find another route when the first route fails

Keep open loops visible and moving

Identify recurring friction and eliminate it through delegation, automation, systemization, or deletion

Give concise updates containing what finished, what changed, what is blocked, your recommendation, and the next date

Protect team from being diverted into Ceo's personal and CEO-level execution work

You do not make medical, relationship, values, or major financial decisions. You own the execution around those decisions and escalate only what truly requires the CEO.

Health-related information must be handled only through approved, privacy-compliant systems and workflows.



What a great day looks like

At the beginning of the day, you know:

What CEO wants moved

What matters most

What can be handled without him

What needs clarification

What must be finished today

During the day, you move mountains:

Close open loops

Push delayed people

Complete health and personal tasks

Convert ideas into action

Remove friction

Protect CEOs time

Solve problems before they reach him

At the end of the day, CEO should not be asking, “What happened with that?”

He should be able to see:

What finished. What changed. What is blocked. What you are handling next.



What winning looks like

After 7 days

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.

title: EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager
description:
EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager

Protect the Founder’s Time. Let Founder do what they're best at.

Remote, Philippines | U.S. Eastern overlap | Full-time

50 hours per week



Compensation and Validation

$2,500/month during the first 90-day validation period

First 14 days are a paid work trial using real work

Operators who far exceed the agreed performance standard move to a $3,500/month base on Day 90, with additional upside as impact and ownership expand. 

Performance is reviewed weekly. Compensation and scope are formally reviewed at Day 90

This is not pay for activity.



You do not earn more by being online, maintaining a task list, or sending pleasant updates. You earn more by finishing meaningful work, protecting CEO's time, solving problems without being chased, and permanently removing work from his plate.



The Day 90 review will consider:

Meaningful work completed

Founder time and attention saved

Recurring responsibilities removed from CEO

Follow-ups eliminated

Blockers solved without founder intervention

Health, personal, and CEO priorities moved forward

Problems converted into delegation, automation, systems, or deletion

Whether CEO had to chase, remind, or re-explain work

If you exceed the agreed standard, your base increases to $3,500/month beginning with the next pay period. Exceptional performance can earn additional upside and expanded ownership.

There will be no surprise standards introduced at Day 90.



This role is for a rare kind of person

You see unfinished work and feel compelled to finish it.

You do not need a founder to explain every obvious next step.

You get genuine satisfaction from taking chaos, pressure, loose ends, and half-formed ideas and turning them into:

“Done. Here’s what changed.”

You are not looking for a job where you wait for instructions and keep a task list updated.

You want to become the person who makes an overloaded founder dramatically lighter.



Why this role exists

Ceo is a visionary.

His highest-value work is thinking, creating, d
, leading, and building the future.

His weakness is that once ideas leave his head, a mountain of execution follows:

Health tasks

Appointments

Records

Research

Follow-ups

Travel

Personal logistics

Errands

Vendors

Scheduling

Projects

Loose ends

When those things remain unfinished, they return to Dylan’s brain. He becomes the reminder system, scheduler, researcher, project manager, and emergency backup.

That steals his time, energy, health, focus, and ability to be fully himself.

Your job is to remove that burden.

Not organize it.

Not report on it.

Finish it.

Your mission

You are the execution engine behind Ceo’s vision.

You will take messy voice notes, ideas, priorities, and unfinished work and turn them into completed outcomes without requiring Ceo to project-manage the middle.



You will:

Clarify the desired outcome.

Identify the next actions.

Own or coordinate the execution.

Push through blockers.

Close the loop with proof.

Prevent the same problem from returning.

Your goal is for Ceo to spend more of his life being authentic by doing only what he should do. 

Thinking

Creating

D

Leading

Building the future

You handle the mountain of execution that allows him to stay in that role.



What you will own

Finish a large volume of meaningful work from Ceo’s active to-do list every day

Protect his calendar, deep work, recovery, health, and personal priorities

Drive health administration from approved decision to completion

Schedule appointments, gather records, prepare documents, and close follow-ups

Turn voice notes and ideas into prioritized action and completed projects

Own travel, Trip preparation, errands, purchases, vendors, reservations, and personal logistics

Chase people, enforce deadlines, remove blockers, and find another route when the first route fails

Keep open loops visible and moving

Identify recurring friction and eliminate it through delegation, automation, systemization, or deletion

Give concise updates containing what finished, what changed, what is blocked, your recommendation, and the next date

Protect team from being diverted into Ceo's personal and CEO-level execution work

You do not make medical, relationship, values, or major financial decisions. You own the execution around those decisions and escalate only what truly requires the CEO.

Health-related information must be handled only through approved, privacy-compliant systems and workflows.



What a great day looks like

At the beginning of the day, you know:

What CEO wants moved

What matters most

What can be handled without him

What needs clarification

What must be finished today

During the day, you move mountains:

Close open loops

Push delayed people

Complete health and personal tasks

Convert ideas into action

Remove friction

Protect CEOs time

Solve problems before they reach him

At the end of the day, CEO should not be asking, “What happened with that?”

He should be able to see:

What finished. What changed. What is blocked. What you are handling next.



What winning looks like

After 7 days

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.

title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers.



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before.

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: REMOTE - CS Representative Pet Brand
description:
Do you like helping people? Are you reliable and can you work on your own? This job might be for you.

We sell and ship our pet products to customers all over the world. We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our CS team. Our young and energized team works fully remotely, and our members live in different countries.



What you will do:

— Answer customer questions

— Follow up with suppliers when a package is late or stuck

— Keep the customer updated on open cases — you check in with the supplier or a colleague if needed, and update the customer until it is fixed

— Help solve delivery issues

— Handle customer orders, returns, and order changes



What we are looking for:

— 3+ years of customer service experience

— Good communication — clear and professional

— Flexible with shifts — we serve customers around the world, so some evenings and weekends are part of the job. To show you read this, include the word "red" in your message.

— Shopify and/or Freshdesk experience is a plus

— Good internet, working camera and mic

— Is comfortable with an NDA, a non-compete agreement, and screencasts

— Able to commit to this as your only job





What you get:

— Start at $4/hr, goes up based on your work

— Performance-based 13th month bonus

— Part-time to start, can grow

— Work from home

— One team trip every year — last year Vietnam, the year before Siargao

— Option for long-term work



Ready to apply? Send your CV and a short letter. Only apply if you meet all the requirements.

The Role



This position will lead the Group's media relations, executive thought leadership, LinkedIn presence and corporate communications.



You will turn business developments, market trends, workforce insights and the impact of AI into compelling stories and commentary for business audiences, primarily in Australia, with growing reach across the US, UK and Asia.



You will also manage an external PR agency in Australia. Lead generation and digital marketing are handled separately.

Brief and manage the Australian PR agency.

Develop content around business developments, workplace culture, client stories and industry insights.

Identify award opportunities and prepare submissions.

title: Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales
description:
Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales



If you’ve ever spotted a way to bring in customers and thought, “I’d love to be the one who runs with that,” you’ll have that opportunity here.



Your job is to figure out where our next students will come from and make the first move. You might get a local organization to introduce the studio to its families, start a conversation with a parent who’s looking for classes, or discover a referral source we’ve overlooked. The owner knows the studio and its students. You bring the outreach experience to turn that knowledge into a steady flow of interested families.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



- Generate new leads. This is your main responsibility. Choose promising outreach channels, build referral relationships, and start conversations. Track which efforts bring interested families to the studio so you know where to invest your time.

- Turn interest into enrollment. About 98% of our students are kids, so most of your conversations will be with parents. We offer adult classes too. Respond promptly to inquiries during your shifts, learn what each person is looking for, and recommend a class they’ll feel confident signing up for.

- Own the follow up. Use calls, texts, and
s to keep conversations moving. Keep the CRM current and give the owner a brief daily update on new leads, bookings, enrollments, and next steps.

- Support the studio with a weekly
 to leads, occasional social media content, and light VA tasks. Sales and outreach come first.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING



Previous sales experience is required, including experience finding your own prospects. We’ll introduce you to our classes and the families we serve. From there, you’ll d
 who to reach, what to say, and what to change when an approach gets few replies.



Strong phone skills matter here. You can put a parent at ease, ask a thoughtful question, listen to the answer, and confidently invite them to enroll. You’ll need C1 level or higher spoken and written English.



We value someone we can count on. When you tell a parent you’ll call on Thursday, you make the call. When an outreach idea shows promise, you take the next step without waiting for a reminder. Previous VA experience is preferred. CRM familiarity and an interest in dance are both welcome.



PAID TRIAL, BASE PAY, AND BONUSES



The role begins with a 2 week paid trial at 20 hours per week. You’ll receive $125 USD total for 40 hours. We’ll agree on your trial shifts in advance.



During the trial, we’ll assess your initiative, lead generation, sales ability, and reliability. We’ll look at the prospects you find independently, the conversations your outreach starts, which ones progress toward bookings or paid enrollments, and how consistently you follow through.



At the end of the trial, we’ll review the results together. If we both d
 to continue, you’ll move to 34 hours per week with a base salary of $450 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks through Wise.



You can earn performance bonuses on top of your base pay when your outreach consistently brings in multiple new paying students per month.



REGULAR SCHEDULE



All times are US Pacific Time.



Monday through Friday: 10 am to 2 pm and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a break from 2 pm to 4 pm.  

Saturday and Sunday: 10 am to noon each day.



That’s 34 hours across 7 days. Both weekend shifts are required. We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. We’ll discuss and agree on any changes in advance.



HOW TO APPLY



Include “Silver Slippers” in your subject line or message title. Send your resume, confirm you can work the full regular schedule, and answer this question in a few sentences:



Tell us about one sales opportunity you created from scratch. How did you find it, what did you personally do to move it forward, and what was the outcome?

Minimum three years of hands-on US government contract billing experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise; five or more years preferred.



Demonstrated understanding of direct and indirect costs, overhead rates and contractual fee calculations.



Strong Excel skills, including lookup functions, SUMIFS, pivot tables, reconciliations and formula-based reporting.



Experience interpreting written contract and invoicing requirements.



Exceptional accuracy, responsiveness and attention to detail.



Ability to attend scheduled working sessions during US Pacific Time, including payroll and invoicing deadlines.



Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of payroll and financial information.



Preferred qualifications



Experience with architecture, engineering, transportation, infrastructure or public-sector consulting firms.



Experience with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Time.



Familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) cost principles.



Certified payroll and prevailing wage reporting experience.



DBE/SBE utilization reporting experience.



Experience supporting government financial audits.



Application instructions

Your résumé and years of government contract invoicing experience.



Examples of government agencies or contractors you have supported.



The types of contracts and billing structures you have worked with.



Your experience with overhead, fees and utilization reporting.



Your availability during US Pacific Time.

ing healthcare offices

 campaigns

Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Brand Management & Growth

Manage multiple Amazon brands and product portfolios.

Analyze sales, profitability, organic rankings, conversion rates, traffic, and advertising performance.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, and grow market share.

Develop and execute strategies to improve underperforming products.

Oversee listing optimization, SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and conversion improvements.

Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities.

Monitor inventory-related issues that affect sales and performance.

Develop clear short-term and long-term growth strategies for assigned brands.

Our expectation: You don't just maintain Amazon listings. You actively manage and grow the business.



2. Data Analysis, Problem Solving & Execution



Strong analytical skills are essential, but identifying problems is only the beginning.

We're looking for someone who can:

Analyze data to identify declining sales, poor conversion rates, advertising inefficiencies, and other performance issues.

Investigate the underlying causes rather than simply reporting numbers.

Develop practical solutions supported by research and data.

Implement corrective actions and coordinate the necessary resources.

Monitor results and continuously improve strategies.

Take responsibility for resolving issues from beginning to end.

We don't need someone who simply tells us what's wrong. We need someone who knows how to fix it and takes action.



3. Amazon Product Launches



You must have direct, hands-on experience launching private-label products on Amazon.

Responsibilities include:

Conducting product and competitor research.

Performing keyword research and analyzing market opportunities.

Developing product launch strategies, budgets, and timelines.

Coordinating product photography, listing content, A+ Content, and launch assets.

Working with PPC specialists on launch campaigns and advertising strategies.

Planning compliant product review acquisition strategies.

Coordinating inventory readiness and launch schedules.

Monitoring launch performance and optimizing strategies to improve rankings, conversions, and sales.

You should understand the complete Amazon launch process, from preparation to successful market entry and continued growth.



4. Team Coordination & Project Management



You'll work directly with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and operations team to ensure brand initiatives are completed effectively.

Coordinate PPC strategies and campaign priorities with advertising specialists.

Work closely with graphic designers to develop listing images, A+ Content, advertising creatives, and product videos.

Assign projects, set clear priorities, and establish realistic due dates.

Manage multiple ongoing projects and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

Review creative assets and campaign initiatives to ensure they support brand objectives.

Identify bottlenecks and resolve delays before they affect performance.

Maintain accountability and clear communication across teams.

Use project management systems to organize assignments, responsibilities, and deadlines.

You must be comfortable leading execution, making decisions, and ensuring that important work gets completed without constant supervision.



5. External Marketing & Brand Development



While Amazon is our main sales channel, we also want to expand our brand presence and customer acquisition efforts beyond Amazon.

Experience or familiarity with the following is valuable:

 and Instagram advertising.

TikTok marketing and short-form video content.

Influencer marketing and UGC creators.

External traffic strategies that drive customers to Amazon.

Affiliate marketing and customer acquisition campaigns.

Shopify and direct-to-consumer marketing.

We're looking for someone who understands how to use outside marketing channels to build brand awareness and support Amazon sales growth.



6. AI Tools, Automation & Operational Improvements



We're continuously improving our business through AI and modern technology.

While this is not a software development position, we value Amazon professionals who are comfortable using AI to improve their productivity and solve business problems.

Experience with the following is a strong advantage:

Claude and Claude Code.

OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT.

AI-assisted Amazon research, analytics, and reporting.

Automating repetitive business tasks and workflows.

Building or customizing simple internal tools using AI.

We especially value people who are willing to invest time in exploring AI-powered applications or automations that eliminate operational bottlenecks and help the company operate more efficiently.



Minimum Qualifications



Required:

At least 4 years of proven Amazon brand management experience, preferably managing US private-label brands.

Demonstrated experience growing Amazon sales and improving brand performance.

Direct experience successfully launching new products on Amazon.

Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and advertising fundamentals.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical solutions.

Experience coordinating with PPC specialists, graphic designers, and other team members.

Excellent project management skills, including assigning priorities and meeting deadlines.

Good understanding of Amazon profitability, margins, conversion rates, and organic rankings.

Familiarity with external marketing strategies.

Strong English communication and independent problem-solving skills.



Highly Preferred:



Experience managing multiple Amazon brands simultaneously.

Advanced knowledge of Data Dive, Helium 10, and Amazon Brand Analytics.

Experience with Meta, TikTok, influencer marketing, or UGC campaigns.

Practical experience using Claude, Codex, and other AI tools.

Experience creating automations, dashboards, or simple internal business applications.

Familiarity with ClickUp, Notion, and workflow management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, results-driven Amazon professional who:

Understands what drives profitable Amazon brand growth.

Can manage multiple brands and identify the right priorities.

Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they're resolved.

Works effectively with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Can independently coordinate projects, deadlines, and resources.

Is constantly looking for opportunities to improve business performance.

Is open to adopting AI tools and developing more efficient systems.



As an experienced Amazon Brand Manager first, with a strong interest in using technology to become even more effective.



What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Develop a clear understanding of your assigned brands and their performance.

Identify the biggest opportunities to improve sales, profitability, and conversion rates.

Create actionable growth plans with measurable objectives.

Resolve high-priority issues affecting brand performance.

Establish effective coordination with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Improve project accountability and timely delivery of creative and marketing initiatives.

Demonstrate strong ownership, independent decision-making, and measurable progress.

Identify opportunities where AI tools or automation could make existing workflows more efficient.



Most importantly, you take ownership of the results.



If this sounds like you and you would like to apply. Please send your resume directly to myself with the subject line : SBM with Passion for AI





Tam Ma

Co Founder - Prodigy Media

description:

- Reliable internet, a headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Availability during agreed U.S. business hours, which may fall in the evening or overnight in the Philippines.



Experience in real estate, foreclosure, or unclaimed property is a plus.

title: Cold Calling Appointment Setter: US Small Businesses (Full-Time, US Hours)(MALE APPLICANTS ONLY)
description:
We are a company that builds websites for small local businesses in Colorado (plumbers, salons, restaurants,

auto shops) and then helps them get found on Google. We build the site first, free, then show it to

the owner. Your job is to call business owners, tell them we've built them something, and book a

15-minute call for our team to walk them through it.



You will:

- make 80 to 120 calls a day from our own calling system, with scripts that fill themselves in for

each business;

- log every call's outcome the same day;

- book meetings onto our team's calendar;

- practice on our AI practice line before you go live.

English; a quiet room, a headset, and reliable internet with a backup. We're looking for candidates who have previous experience working with a digital marketing agency, as the position requires familiarity with digital marketing services and communicating their value to business owners.



Schedule: full-time, Monday to Friday, US Mountain business hours.



Pay: Basic pay + Commission



To apply: start your application with the word SPARROW.



Then answer:

(1) What's the hardest objection you've handled on a cold call, and what did you say?

(2) Record a 60-second voice note introducing yourself as if you were calling a busy plumber.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Financial Analyst



Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Financial Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing financial data, preparing financial reports, developing budgets and forecasts, and providing valuable insights to support strategic business decisions.



This role requires strong analytical skills, proficiency in financial modeling, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.



Key Responsibilities:

- Analyze financial data, business performance, revenue, expenses, and profitability.

- Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

- Develop and maintain financial models, budgets, and forecasts.

- Conduct financial variance analysis and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

- Monitor key financial performance indicators (KPIs) and provide recommendations to management.

- Evaluate financial performance and support business planning initiatives.

- Prepare financial presentations, dashboards, and management reports.

- Collaborate with internal teams to gather and validate financial information.

- Ensure accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality of financial records and reports.

- Support ad hoc financial analysis and other finance-related projects as needed.



Qualifications and Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or any science-related or relevant quantitative field.

- Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), or corporate finance.

- Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and financial modeling.

- Experience analyzing financial data and preparing management reports.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- High attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.



Compensation and Probationary Period

- Probationary Period: 90 days

- Probationary Salary: ₱20,000–₱30,000 per month

- Post-Probationary Salary: ₱30,000–₱80,000 per month (negotiable)

title: Procurement And Bidding Specialist
description:
BID ASSISTANT — U.S. GOVERNMENT CONTRACTS







PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING







COMPENSATION & COMMITMENT







• Monthly expenses: USD $300 to cover expenses. This is not a salary.

• Commission: 10% of the profit on each contract you bring in, with no cap.

• Commission is calculated on profit, not the total contract value.

• Full-time commitment and availability for long working hours are required.

• You must have no other job or ongoing studies.





We pursue U.S. government contracts worth over $1 million, targeting at least 10% profit. These are targets, not guaranteed outcomes.





ILLUSTRATIVE EARNINGS EXAMPLE







Contract value: $1,000,000

Profit generated: $100,000

Your commission: $10,000





This example is not a promise of earnings or a monthly salary.





Please apply only if these compensation terms and commitment requirements suit you.





ABOUT THE ROLE







We are looking for driven, resourceful, and experienced Bid Assistants to help us win U.S. government contracts.





You will identify opportunities, source competitive pricing, prepare compliant bids, and help secure profitable contracts. This role suits someone who understands federal procurement, works independently, and is motivated by performance-based rewards.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES







• Monitor government contracting portals daily.

• Analyse RFQs, RFIs, and solicitation requirements.

• Source vendors and negotiate competitive, profitable pricing.

• Prepare and submit professional, fully compliant bid packages.

• Maintain your opportunity pipeline and follow up consistently.

• Develop pricing strategies that balance competitiveness and profit.

• Take ownership of your work and remain accountable for progress.





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR







• Government bidding experience: You understand U.S. federal procurement from opportunity identification to award.





• Strong English: You can interpret complex documents, communicate professionally, and write clear proposals.





• Technical confidence: You can navigate government portals, manage documents, and assemble accurate submissions.





• Performance motivation: You are self-motivated and comfortable with the compensation structure outlined above.





• Persistence: You follow through, solve problems, and move forward after unsuccessful bids.





• Commercial judgement: You know how to balance competitive pricing with healthy profit margins.





WHY JOIN US?







• Uncapped commission based on the profit from contracts you bring in.

• Work alongside professionals with over 20 years of experience in federal contracting.

• Opportunities for high performers to progress into team leadership or strategy roles.

title: Looking for Mechanical engineer
description:
We are looking for experienced contract mechanical design engineers to support our internal engineering team. We anticipate starting with one contractor, potentially expanding to 2–3 as project demand increases.

Engagement

title: Senior Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing Specialist - Multi-Category Supplier Development (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established US-based Amazon FBA wholesale seller. We are looking for ONE senior sourcing person to bring in new suppliers across categories and turn their price lists into profitable orders, working directly with the owner. This is a long-term role.



HOURS

40 hrs/week, remote. You must overlap at least 4 hours with US Central time (9 AM - 5 PM CT).



PAY

$4-5/hour depending on experience, PLUS a quarterly profit bonus: 5% of net profit on the products you source that hit our ROI target.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Supplier development (main focus)

- Find and open new wholesale suppliers in any category that works on Amazon: Health & Household, Home & Kitchen, Grocery, Pet, Baby, Sports, Tools, Beauty and more

- Target authorized distributors, brands (brand-direct) and manufacturers, in the US and internationally

- Qualify every supplier before we apply: legitimacy, brand authorization, pricing, MOQs, payment and shipping terms, landed cost for international suppliers

- Run outreach 
, phone, applications) and follow up until the account is approved

- Keep a supplier pipeline sheet updated: status, contact, terms and next step



Sourcing

- Analyze supplier price lists and catalogs (hundreds to thousands of lines) and recommend Buy / Buy smaller / Skip with quantities

- Apply our sourcing criteria: net ROI after returns, profit per unit, seller count, Amazon Buy Box share, price stability, sales velocity

- Plan replenishment for products we already sell

- Check every order before the PO goes out: exact ASIN match, pack size, Transparency, IP history, gating, hazmat and restricted-product claims



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of US Amazon FBA WHOLESALE experience (not only online arbitrage)

- A proven record of opening wholesale accounts across several categories (brand-direct and distributors)

- Expert at Keepa: graphs, Buy Box history, seller counts, stock levels

- Strong Google Sheets skills (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, cleaning messy price lists)

- Clear understanding of FBA fees, ROI vs margin, case packs and multi-packs

- Strong written and spoken English; reliable internet and a backup power source



NICE TO HAVE

- Existing distributor or brand relationships you can bring

- Importing experience: international freight, customs/duties, US labeling rules

- Ungating experience; Sellerboard, Seller Snap, SellerAmp, SmartScout or similar tools



HOW TO APPLY

Include ALL of the following in your application:

1. Years of US Amazon WHOLESALE experience, and the categories and suppliers/brands you sourced from (names are enough)
