title: Community Engagement Specialist (skincare industry)
description:
We're looking for a Community Engagement Specialist to act as an extension

of the social team at a well-established clinical skincare brand. You will build the

brand's relevance beyond its own channels by joining conversations on TikTok,

Instagram, and Threads, contributing real skincare knowledge, and bringing the

brand's personality to the conversations shaping its customers' world.

This is a proactive engagement role. You will find the conversations that matter,

including skincare concerns, ingredients, trends, and cultural moments, and join

them with helpful, science-backed replies that sound native to each platform. The

ideal person blends skincare expertise with social media experience and can

translate skin science into approachable language without losing credibility. This

role is dedicated only to proactive community engagement, not customer service,

inbox management, or moderation of the brand's own channels. If you can join a

conversation confidently, explain the science in plain language, and keep a

distinct brand voice, this role is a strong fit.

What You'll Work On

Proactive Engagement

● Identify and join relevant conversations on TikTok, Instagram, and

Threads, with a focus on skincare concerns, ingredients, trends, and

cultural moments

● Bring credible, science-backed skincare knowledge into conversations

through helpful, engaging, and approachable responses

● Keep the brand's scientific authority and a conversational, culturally

relevant personality in balance so replies feel native to each platform

Collaboration and Insights

● Partner closely with the Assistant Community Manager on engagement

priorities, trending topics, and opportunities to join conversations

● Surface recurring consumer questions, emerging discussions, and

opportunities that can inform the broader content and community strategy

● Keep up with the brand's formulations, science, and messaging through

ongoing product and skincare education

Claims and Compliance

● Navigate skincare claims responsibly, with a clear line between cosmetic

education and medical advice

● Work within approved messaging and escalate anything that touches

medical claims or sensitive topics

What You Bring

● A background in esthetics, dermatology, skincare education, or a related

field, ideally paired with experience supporting a consumer-facing beauty

or skincare brand

● Experience in social media community management, especially proactive

engagement or social listening

● Experience with a science-, health-, or clinically led brand, with an

understanding of product claims, regulatory considerations, and

boundaries around medical advice

● Strong writing skills and the ability to turn scientific information into

approachable, brand-right responses

● Deep familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and Threads, including platform

culture, consumer behavior, and emerging trends

● Comfort collaborating with an internal brand team and learning the brand's

products and messaging

● Available to work during US business hours

Nice to Have

● Esthetician license, dermatology experience, or formal skincare education

● Experience in social listening tools or trend tracking

● Experience engaging as a brand voice on social platforms rather than only

posting content

● Familiarity with cosmetic claims and advertising guidelines for skincare

title: Remote Sales Associate / Sales Assistant: Creator Accounts
description:
I run a small digital media agency. Most of our revenue comes from clients who buy from us again and again. I'm hiring a full-time sales associate to join a small, friendly team: look after our clients, keep them happy, and grow what they spend with us.



You must already have hands-on experience with Infloww or OnlyMonster. These are the chat and CRM platforms we use every day, and I want someone who can log in and start working without being taught the tool.



This isn't cold calling. You'll message clients who already know us. Your job is to build the relationship and spot the right moment to offer the next thing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage client chats on our CRM platform

- Know every client: keep notes and tags on each one (preferences, purchase history, what they've told you)

- Upsell: recommend products and upgrades that fit each client, quoted from a fixed price list

- Follow up: welcome new clients, check in on quiet ones, and remind clients before their membership renews

- Log your work: a simple daily log of follow-ups and sales

- Flag problems early: an unhappy client, an unusual request or anything that feels off comes to the team lead



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- REQUIRED: hands-on experience with Infloww or OnlyMonster

- Chat sales, upselling, retention or account management experience

- Excellent written English: natural, casual and warm, not scripted. Near-native preferred.

- You remember people, and you write everything down

- Fast, accurate typing (40+ WPM)

- Trustworthy: client information stays confidential

- Reliable. This is the most important one. You show up for every shift, and you tell us early if you can't.



HOURS AND PAY

- Full-time: 6 shifts a week, 8 hours each

- Shifts rotate between nights (10 PM – 6 AM Manila) and days (9 AM – 5 PM Manila), changing mid-week

- USD $400/month (about $2/hour)

- Paid twice a month (15th and last day) by Wise. Independent contractor.

- Paid training and a paid trial shift before you're hired

- Your own computer, stable internet and a backup connection

TO APPLY, SEND:

1. Which platform have you used (Infloww, OnlyMonster or both), and for how long?

Applications that don't answer questions 1 and 2 won't be reviewed.

Shortlisted applicants get the full details of the role and the clients before any interview.

title: General & Technical Virtual Assistant (VA)
description:
Aura Designs – General & Technical Virtual Assistant (VA)

Compensation: $6 USD/hour to start; increases to $7 USD/hour after 90 days upon demonstrated performance.



Location: Remote (international applicants welcome)

Employment Type: Full-time contract, 40 hours/week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours/day; minimum 4 hours daily overlap with Eastern Time (Montreal)

Reports to: Founder, Aura Designs

Apply here: 

Who We Are

Aura Designs is a Canadian digital marketing and web development agency helping businesses grow through high-performing websites, marketing strategies, and streamlined digital systems. We serve fitness, home services, professional services, e-commerce, and other businesses.

Our services include WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify websites; Meta and Google advertising; SEO,
 and social media marketing; GoHighLevel CRM and automations; landing pages and funnels; and ongoing website support. We value quality, efficiency, accountability, and strong client relationships.

The Role Overview

We’re seeking a dependable General & Technical Virtual Assistant to work directly with the founder. Your primary focus will be hands-on technical implementation and client support: updating existing WordPress and Shopify sites, configuring GoHighLevel workflows and funnels, handling routine client requests, and preparing reports. General administrative support, including inbox, calendar, research and data entry, will be a secondary part of the role.





The goal is to reliably execute clearly scoped work using existing tools, templates and processes, keep client requests moving, and reduce the founder’s workload. This is an implementation and support position, not a senior developer, advanced automation architect or project management role. You should be organized, resourceful, proactive and comfortable asking questions when a task exceeds your experience.

What We’re Looking For

Secondary General Assistant Skills

Executive and administrative assistance for a business owner

Inbox triage,
 drafting, calendar coordination and scheduling

Professional first-level customer support and client communication

Online research, accurate data entry, spreadsheet and contact-list maintenance

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong organization, prioritization, discretion and proactive updates

Essential Technical Implementation Skills

GoHighLevel: subaccounts, pipelines, workflows,
/SMS automations, forms, calendars and funnels

WordPress: content updates, plugin management, troubleshooting and routine maintenance

Elementor and WPBakery: page population, layouts and responsive fixes

Shopify: products, collections, pages, apps and basic storefront changes

HTML and CSS: practical styling and layout changes

Basic website troubleshooting: identify common plugin, formatting, form and layout issues, and escalate more complex problems

Troubleshooting and testing website functionality and CRM automations

Nice-to-Have Skills

 Basic PHP, WooCommerce, WPML, Shopify Liquid and complex troubleshooting

Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics and Tag Manager

Zapier, Make, APIs, DNS/hosting and advanced integrations

ClickUp, Asana or Trello

Previous agency experience

Core Responsibilities

1. WordPress & Shopify Website Support

Update text, images, pages, products and site content within existing websites

Populate website builds with supplied copy and assets

Adjust Elementor and WPBakery layouts, including mobile responsiveness

Perform routine plugin and site updates and investigate common issues; escalate complex errors

Implement approved scripts, tracking codes and integrations

Make basic HTML and CSS adjustments within existing layouts

Test forms, links, buttons and site functionality; escalate advanced development

2. GoHighLevel CRM & Funnel Implementation

Set up client subaccounts, pipelines and opportunity stages using established processes

Configure standard
/SMS workflows, forms, surveys, calendars and landing pages from briefs or templates

Duplicate and populate funnels using existing templates

Import, clean, tag and segment contacts; configure custom fields

Assist with standard domain connections and approved integrations using documented steps

Test triggers, automations, forms and lead routing; document setups

3. Customer Support & Client Communication

Acknowledge routine client inquiries and technical support requests

Gather missing information, share approved updates and record resolutions

Escalate sensitive, complex or high-impact matters to the founder

4. Client Reporting & Weekly Recaps

Gather performance metrics and activity updates from relevant platforms

Prepare weekly client summaries of completed work, leads, spend, CPC/CPL where relevant

Highlight outstanding items, risks and upcoming priorities

Maintain reporting spreadsheets and draft client updates for review

5. Quality Control & Proactive Problem Solving

Test changes on desktop and mobile before marking tasks complete

Verify forms, links, integrations and automations

Catch formatting errors, missing assets and incorrect settings

Document unresolved issues, communicate blockers early and suggest improvements

Handle credentials and client data securely

6. Executive & Administrative Assistance

Help organize the founder’s daily reminders, assigned tasks and follow-ups

Schedule meetings and maintain files, documents and client information

Prepare meeting notes, summaries, action items and routine documents

Keep task lists and assigned project information current

7. Inbox & Calendar Management

Monitor, sort and prioritize incoming messages

Draft routine responses and flag urgent client requests

Coordinate appointments and meeting availability

Track outstanding communications and follow up when authorized

8. Research, Data Entry & Community Engagement

Conduct assigned research on potential clients, industries and business opportunities

Identify and join relevant groups using authorized accounts

Engage authentically in appropriate conversations and track activity

Maintain research spreadsheets, contact records and lead trackers

Follow platform rules and approved outreach guidelines

Performance Expectations & Progression

90-Day Trial: You’ll start at $6 USD/hour. During the first three months, we expect you to:



1. Complete at least 10 routine website updates or technical support requests accurately, including testing before completion.



2. Configure or meaningfully support at least 3 GoHighLevel client setups, workflows, funnels or CRM implementations.



3. Independently manage routine inbox, calendar, research and administrative assignments with minimal follow-up.



4. Deliver 100% of assigned weekly client recaps on schedule, with accurate activity and performance information.



5. Maintain an average 24–48-business-hour turnaround for standard website and CRM support requests when required access and assets are available.



After 90 Days: If you consistently meet these expectations, deliver quality work and operate with minimal oversight, your rate increases to $7 USD/hour following a successful performance review.

Key Performance Metrics

• Task completion: 95% of assigned tasks on time

• Accuracy: 95% without significant errors or rework

• Communication: clear daily updates on scheduled workdays

Responsiveness: acknowledge new tasks within 2 working hours

Website support: routine requests typically completed within 24–48 business hours, subject to complexity

CRM implementation: standard setups within agreed deadlines

Client reporting: 100% of assigned weekly recaps on time

Proactivity: at least 2 useful improvements or identified issues per week

Working Hours & Availability

This is a full-time remote contract position requiring 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, 8 hours per day. Maintain a consistent agreed schedule with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with Eastern Time in Montreal (which observes daylight saving time). Attend scheduled check-ins, communicate during work hours, meet deadlines and provide advance notice of planned absences.

Must-Have Qualities

Detail-oriented: catch errors before they reach clients

Self-starter: investigate and execute without constant supervision

Resourceful: research and troubleshoot effectively

Organized: manage competing tasks and deadlines

Reliable communicator: provide updates and flag blockers

Fast learner: adapt to new platforms and processes

Accountable: own mistakes and resolve problems

Professional and trustworthy: protect confidential client information

Why Join Aura Designs?

Work directly with an experienced agency founder and gain practical exposure to WordPress, Shopify, GoHighLevel, automation and digital marketing. Enjoy diverse projects, remote work, professional development and the opportunity to grow into a trusted long-term team member.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Resume or professional profile showing relevant general and technical VA experience.

2. Examples of GoHighLevel setups, workflows or funnels you’ve implemented.

3. Examples of WordPress or Shopify websites you’ve maintained.

4. Summary of Elementor, WPBakery and basic HTML/CSS skills; mention PHP only if applicable.

5. Examples of inbox, calendar, customer support or research work.

6. Timezone, working hours and confirmation of 40-hour weekly availability.

7. Short introduction explaining why you’re a fit.

Bonus: Describe a website or CRM problem you investigated and resolved.





Apply here: 





We value practical experience, initiative, reliability and problem-solving over formal qualifications.

title: Real Estate Team Lead – Australian Buyers Agency (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Lead a growing Australian property team, remotely, from the Philippines.



Are you an experienced real estate professional who loves bringing order to a busy pipeline and helping a team do its best work? Charlie Property is looking for a Team Lead to own our Buyers Agency: its people, its client journey, and its growth.



THE QUICK DETAILS

- Role: Buyers Agency Manager (Team Lead)

- Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, with a direct line to the Director on strategy

- Setup: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hours/week)

- Ramp-up: Part-time (20 hours/week) during training and probation, then full-time

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, within Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT), including our weekly Buyers Agency meeting every Tuesday at 1:00 PM Melbourne time

- Rate: USD 8 to 10 per hour

- Start: As soon as possible

- Location: Remote, must be based in the Philippines



WHO WE ARE

Charlie Property is an Australian property investment business led by Director Charles Corby. We buy, renovate and hold residential property with our money partners, and our Buyers Agency helps clients buy the right property. Our team works remotely across Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.



We celebrate differences. We value open communication, different points of view and respectful debate, and we use AI tools and clear systems every day to work smarter.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You'll lead a team of four (Sales and Customer Success) across Australia, Vietnam and Indonesia, making sure every client moves smoothly from first call to settlement. This is a non-transacting role: you lead and coordinate the team, and you won't act as the buyer's agent for clients.



Day to day, you will:

- Lead your team with weekly 30-minute one-on-ones, clear weekly priorities, and early, kind feedback

- Run the weekly Buyers Agency meeting and make sure every action has one owner and a due date in ClickUp

- Within your first 30 days, map out and document who owns each step of the client journey

- Review the GoHighLevel pipeline at least twice a week, chase stuck clients, and make sure every new client comes through the application form

- Lead strategy for client acquisition, agent relationships and off-market deal flow (including stale-listing agent outreach), and bring one improvement or test to the Director each month

- Be the main point of contact for Acquisitions, Marketing and Finance

- Keep Buyers Agency SOPs current, including the AML SOP and client expectation-setting

- Help keep the team within real estate licensing rules, making sure licensed work goes to a licensed person

- Send the Director a short weekly report every Friday: pipeline by stage, clients signed, deals presented, settlements, blockers and decisions needed



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- By day 30: client journey ownership is agreed and documented, and all carried-over actions are closed or re-planned with an owner

- Every week: a clear update is sent to the Ops Team

- Ongoing: ready-to-sign clients move to contract, conversion is tracked by stage in GoHighLevel, and agent outreach runs daily across NSW, VIC and QLD



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE

- Several years working in or managing an Australian buyers agency, and 3+ years in Australian residential property

- 3+ years leading or coordinating a team (remote or cross-cultural is a big plus)

- A solid understanding of investing strategies like buy-and-hold, renovation and flipping

- Experience running a sales or client pipeline with targets

- Confidence with GoHighLevel, ClickUp and Google Workspace, and the ability to own and fix them

- Clear, warm and direct communication

- Availability during Melbourne business hours



BONUS POINTS FOR

- A real estate licence or Cert IV in Real Estate Practice

- Experience running a property education course or program

- Experience with RP Data (CoreLogic) or similar

- Using AI tools in your daily work



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Jibble, Claude (AI assistant), GoHighLevel, RP Data (CoreLogic), and Webflow (via Marketing)



HOW WE WORK

- Remote first: we write things down and keep tasks updated in ClickUp

- Daily rhythm: clock in with Jibble, join the daily AI Hour, and send an EOD report before logging off

- Weekly check-ins: all-hands meeting plus a 1:1 with your manager

- Growth: team coaching with an external coach, AI training, and the chance to build systems that make work easier



WHAT WE OFFER

- USD 8 to 10 per hour

- Remote, full-time role within Melbourne business hours

- A part-time start during training and probation, so you can learn our systems before moving to full-time

- A daily AI Hour to learn and use AI tools at work

- Team coaching sessions with an external coach



HOW TO APPLY

Please read carefully. Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.



1. Use this subject line: "Team Lead Application – [Your Full Name]"

2. Start your message with the words "Settlement Ready" so we know you read the full post

3. Attach your CV or resume

4. Include a link to a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and sharing why this role is right for you

5. Answer these questions in your message:

   a. How many years have you worked with an Australian buyers agency, and what was your role?

   b. How many people have you led, and were they remote?

   c. Which CRM or pipeline tools have you used, and how did you use them to track conversions?

   d. Imagine you join and find clients stuck in the pipeline with no clear owner. What would you do in your first two weeks?

   e. Are you available Monday to Friday during Melbourne business hours, including Tuesdays at 1:00 PM Melbourne time?



OUR HIRING PROCESS

1. Application and video review

2. Interview with the Chief Operations Officer and Director

3. Paid trial task

4. Offer and onboarding



We're excited to hear from you!

title: Amazon DSP Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP) Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale Amazon DSP advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts, with additional experience in Amazon PPC advertising.



This is a client-facing role. The ideal candidate can present performance updates, explain advertising strategies, answer client questions, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations. The primary focus is DSP strategy, audience targeting, optimization, and performance analysis, while PPC knowledge supports integrated advertising plans. The specialist will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead.



Key Responsibilities

Amazon DSP Campaign Management (Primary Focus)

* Manage and optimize Amazon DSP campaigns across multiple client accounts.

* Develop full-funnel DSP strategies for awareness, acquisition, retargeting, and conversion.

* Build campaigns using first-party audiences, behavioral and contextual targeting, and custom audiences.

* Manage prospecting, remarketing, and competitor conquesting initiatives.

* Optimize budgets, bids, audience segments, frequency caps, placements, and creative performance.

* Analyze campaign, audience, placement, and ASIN-level results; track spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rates, reach, frequency, and attributed sales.

* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), where available, to support audience insights and measurement.

* Audit campaigns, identify wasted spend and incremental growth opportunities, and maintain effective budget pacing.

* Partner with creative teams to assess display, video, and other DSP assets



Amazon PPC Management (Secondary Focus)

* Support Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Apply working knowledge of keywords, product targeting, match types, bids, and placements.

* Review ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, CTR, CPC, and conversion performance.

* Coordinate DSP and PPC strategies to support overall sales and advertising efficiency.



Performance Analysis & Strategic Growth

* Identify trends, inefficiencies, growth opportunities, and potential root causes of performance changes.

* Consider organic sales, product rankings, pricing, inventory, and conversion rates when making recommendations.

* Develop and execute structured tests of audiences, creatives, placements, and campaign formats.

* Evaluate how DSP and PPC contribute together to broader Amazon advertising goals.



Client Communication & Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

* Join client meetings, present results, and explain strategy and next steps clearly.

* Proactively communicate risks, opportunities, and data-backed recommendations.

* Document campaign optimizations, tests, findings, and decisions.



AI, Automation & Advertising Technology

* Use approved AI, analytics, automation, and advertising tools to improve efficiency and decision-making.

* Automate appropriate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Stay current with Amazon DSP developments and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* 5+ years of hands-on Amazon advertising experience, including significant direct Amazon DSP campaign management.

* Strong expertise in DSP campaign setup, audience targeting, full-funnel strategy, optimization, reporting, and budget management.

* Working knowledge of Amazon PPC and Sponsored Ads campaign types.

* Understanding of attribution, campaign performance metrics, and profitability analysis.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

* Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently, diagnose problems, and meet deadlines.

* Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence presenting to U.S. clients.

* Comfortable with AI tools, automation, and advertising management software.



Preferred Experience

* Advanced DSP experience across multiple brands or agency accounts.

* Experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud, including audience creation and advanced measurement.

* Familiarity with Amazon Marketing Stream, third-party reporting tools, and advertising data integrations.

* Experience coordinating DSP and PPC strategies.

title: Car Rental Fleet Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on and resourceful Car Rental Fleet Manager to oversee vehicle repair coordination, maintenance scheduling, mechanic assignments, and fleet inventory management.



In this role, you will receive reports of vehicle breakdowns, mechanical issues, customer complaints, and repair requests. You will be responsible for understanding the reported issues, identifying the likely repairs needed, coordinating with available mechanics, assigning repair jobs, and ensuring that repairs are completed within a reasonable timeframe.



The ideal candidate has a good understanding of vehicle mechanics, can confidently communicate repair requirements to mechanics, and is capable of managing multiple repair jobs, schedules, and inventory requirements to keep the rental fleet operational and minimise downtime.





Key Responsibilities



Vehicle Repair Assessment and Diagnosis



Receive and assess reports of vehicle breakdowns, mechanical problems, customer complaints, and repair requests.

Understand reported symptoms and identify possible mechanical faults and the repairs required.

Conduct initial troubleshooting to determine the likely cause of vehicle issues and the urgency of repairs.

Clearly explain vehicle issues, repair requirements, and priorities to assigned mechanics.

Determine whether a vehicle requires immediate repair, further inspection, or routine maintenance.

Monitor recurring mechanical problems and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

Mechanic Assignment and Coordination



Identify and contact available mechanics or service providers based on the type of repair, availability, location, and urgency.

Assign repair and maintenance jobs to appropriate mechanics.

Coordinate with mechanics to ensure they understand the reported issue, scope of work, and expected turnaround time.

Follow up with mechanics regarding repair progress, delays, and completion.

Maintain a network of reliable mechanics and service providers who can support different vehicle repair requirements.

Coordinate additional support when a repair requires specialised expertise.

Scheduling and Fleet Maintenance



Manage and schedule vehicle repairs, maintenance, servicing, inspections, and other fleet-related work.

Coordinate mechanic schedules and assign jobs based on repair priorities and availability.

Ensure urgent vehicle issues are attended to promptly.

Monitor repair timelines and follow up to ensure jobs are completed as scheduled.

Coordinate vehicle availability with rental bookings and operational requirements.

Minimise vehicle downtime by efficiently managing repair schedules and prioritising vehicles that need to return to service.

Inventory and Parts Management



Monitor inventory of vehicle parts, tools, supplies, and other maintenance-related materials.

Identify parts required for scheduled repairs and coordinate their availability before work begins.

Track inventory usage, stock levels, and replenishment requirements.

Coordinate sourcing and purchasing of parts when necessary.

Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure commonly used parts are available to avoid unnecessary repair delays.

Fleet Monitoring and Record Management



Maintain updated records of vehicle condition, repair history, maintenance schedules, and current operational status.

Track vehicles that are available for rental, undergoing repairs, awaiting parts, or temporarily out of service.

Document repair reports, mechanic assignments, parts used, repair costs, and completion dates.

Keep relevant stakeholders updated on vehicle status, repair progress, and expected availability.

Maintain organised and accurate fleet maintenance records.

Reporting and Operational Improvement



Provide updates on outstanding repairs, mechanic assignments, vehicle availability, and inventory requirements.

Monitor repair turnaround times and identify recurring delays or operational issues.

Identify opportunities to improve mechanic coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and repair processes.

Recommend practical ways to improve fleet reliability and reduce maintenance-related downtime.



Other Responsibilities

Make necessary process suggestions and improvements which can help the team.

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on.



About You

You're a hands-on, resourceful, and highly organised professional with a strong understanding of vehicle mechanics, repair processes, and fleet maintenance operations. You're capable of assessing reported vehicle issues, identifying likely repairs, coordinating mechanics, and managing multiple repair jobs and schedules. You take ownership of issues from initial report through to resolution and are comfortable working independently in a fast-paced operational environment.



Essential Experience and Skills

3–5 years of experience in fleet management, fleet maintenance, automotive repair, workshop operations, or a related automotive role.

Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

Practical knowledge of vehicle mechanics, common mechanical faults, troubleshooting, and repair requirements.

Ability to assess vehicle breakdown reports, customer complaints, and reported symptoms to identify likely mechanical issues and determine the appropriate repairs.

Experience coordinating, scheduling, and assigning mechanics or automotive technicians based on repair requirements, availability, and urgency.

Experience managing multiple repair jobs, monitoring progress, and following up to ensure timely completion.

Knowledge of routine vehicle servicing, preventative maintenance, inspections, and repair scheduling.

Experience monitoring vehicle parts, supplies, inventory levels, and replenishment requirements.

Ability to communicate repair requirements clearly to mechanics, workshops, and service providers.

Strong organisational, prioritisation, and time management skills, particularly when handling multiple vehicles and urgent repairs.

Ability to maintain accurate records of vehicle repairs, maintenance history, mechanic assignments, inventory, and vehicle status.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions regarding repair priorities and fleet operational requirements.

Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and coordinate effectively in a remote working environment.





Nice to Have

Experience working in a car rental, vehicle hire, transport, logistics, or automotive service business.

Previous experience as an automotive mechanic, workshop supervisor, service advisor, fleet maintenance coordinator, or workshop manager.

Experience coordinating independent mechanics, external workshops, and third-party service providers.

Experience sourcing automotive parts, obtaining repair quotations, and coordinating repair costs.

Familiarity with fleet management systems, vehicle maintenance tracking tools, or inventory management systems.

Knowledge of vehicle roadworthiness requirements, inspections, and maintenance compliance.

Experience managing or coordinating the maintenance of multiple vehicles within an active rental fleet.

Experience working in a remote operations environment and coordinating with geographically dispersed teams or service providers.





Finer Details

Schedule: TBD

Start Date:

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper — Multi-Entity (QuickBooks + Tekmetric) | US Auto Repair Group
description:
We're a US-based holding company that owns and operates a growing group of independent automotive repair shops across Texas. We acquire shops and bring them onto a shared accounting platform, so the books span multiple legal entities (operating companies, a holding company, and property-holding entities) with transactions flowing between them.

You'll own the day-to-day and month-end books across all entities in QuickBooks Enterprise. A US CPA reviews and files; your job is to deliver clean, reconciled, close-ready books and supporting schedules every month so that review is fast and the filings are accurate. This is a finance-operations role, not data entry. As we close new acquisitions, you'll onboard each new shop into the books — so the role grows with the portfolio.



What you'll own



- Multi-entity bookkeeping in Quickbooks — maintain accurate books across the holding company, multiple operating shops, and property entities.

- Accounts payable — enter and code vendor bills (including auto parts and tire suppliers), manage the AP schedule, prep payment runs for approval.

- Accounts receivable — record customer invoicing where applicable and follow up on open balances.

- Payroll — record and reconcile payroll across entities.

- Reconciliations — monthly bank and credit-card reconciliations for every entity, plus loan and liability accounts.

- Parts cost reconciliation — match parts purchases and repair orders from our shop-management system (Tekmetric) against QuickBooks; investigate and flag variances between what was bought, what was billed, and what was booked.

- Intercompany — track and keep clean the transactions between entities (rent between property and operating companies, management fees from the holding company, owner draws/loans).

- Month-end close — accruals, prepaids, reconciliations, and supporting schedules; deliver close-ready books to our CPA for review and filing.

- Reporting — monthly P&L and balance sheet by entity plus a consolidated view; proactively flag anomalies, margin movements, and anything that looks off.

- New-shop onboarding — when we acquire a shop, set up or clean its chart of accounts, load opening balances, and standardize it onto our platform.

- Documentation & support — maintain a clean audit trail and support diligence, lender/SBA reporting, and annual tax prep.



Requirements



- 5+ years of full-charge bookkeeping for US-based clients (multi-entity experience strongly preferred).

- Expert in QuickBooks 

- Comfortable working on the accrual basis and running a month-end close.

- Strong reconciliation discipline and obsessive accuracy — you catch the small stuff before it compounds.

- Clear written English and proactive communication — you flag issues early instead of sitting on them.

- Reliable computer (i5 or better, 8GB+ RAM) and internet 50 Mbps; able to work the overlap window above.

- Looking for a long-term, full-time, single-client commitment.



Bonus (not required, but moves you to the top of the pile)



- QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

- Experience with auto repair, multi-location retail, or field-service businesses.

- Familiarity with a shop-management system (Tekmetric, Shopmonkey, Mitchell, etc.) and/or a parts/spend reconciliation tool (WickedFile, Ramp).

- Experience supporting a US CPA through close and tax filing.

- Experience onboarding newly acquired entities (roll-up / M&A bookkeeping).



Why this role

You'll be the financial backbone of a fast-growing operator, with real ownership and visibility into how acquisitions are run. As the portfolio grows, there's room to take on more responsibility and eventually help build out a small finance team. We pay above the local market for the right person and reward people who take ownership.

title: US Cold Caller + Closer (Website Sales, $250 Per Close)
description:
We build websites for US small businesses that don't have one (contractors, HVAC, restaurants, salons and more). You call the owner, get them interested and book a quick callback. Within 1-2 hours our team builds a custom preview of their new website. You call them back, text them the preview link, walk them through it and close the sale.



We offer two plans: a setup fee plus a monthly plan, or a $0 upfront website with a $250-300 monthly plan that covers hosting, maintenance, changes and support.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make 150-300 outbound calls per day to US business owners (we provide the leads, script and dialer)

- First call: reach the owner, qualify them, collect what we need for the preview (services, photos or logo if they have them) and lock in a callback 1-2 hours later

- Callback: text them their preview website, walk them through it and close them on our setup fee + monthly plan. If they can't do the setup fee, offer the $0 upfront monthly plan as a backup.

- Send our Stripe link to start their plan (you never take card details over the phone)

- Log every call, callback and close in a shared Google Sheet

- Work US business hours (9am-5pm Eastern, Monday-Friday)



WHAT WE NEED

- 1+ year of US outbound sales or cold calling experience (closing, not just appointment setting)

- Clear, confident English with a neutral accent

- Quiet room, headset, stable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power

- Organized: you will juggle several same-day callbacks at once

- Comfortable hearing "no" 50 times a day and still sounding fresh on call 51



PAY

- $500-650/month base (based on experience) plus commission on every client you close:

  - Setup fee + monthly plan: $250 per close

  - $0 upfront + monthly plan (backup offer): $50 per close, paid once the client's second monthly payment clears

- 2-week paid trial. Top performers get raised base and bonuses.

- Example: 3 setup-fee closes + 3 backup closes a month = $900 in commission on top of base



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "PREVIEW" so we know you read this.

2. Send a 1-2 minute voice recording of you pitching an example website sale to a business owner (Vocaroo or Google Drive link).

3. Tell us your best month in sales: what you sold, the price and how many you closed.



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Qualified High School English Teacher | Online Teaching | US & Australian Students
description:
About The Classic High School Teacher



The Classic High School Teacher is a growing international education company supporting teenagers and their families across the United States, Australia and Canada.



Founded by an experienced secondary school teacher, our business is built on a simple belief:



**Teenagers deserve to be taught by actual teachers.**



We specialise in helping students develop the English skills they need to succeed in secondary school, particularly reading comprehension, literary analysis, analytical writing and essay development.



We are launching **The English Lab**, a premium online English teaching programme, and are recruiting qualified secondary school English teachers to join our founding teaching team.



## Who We Are Looking For



**You must be a qualified secondary/high school English teacher with genuine classroom teaching experience.**



We are NOT looking for general English tutors, ESL conversation teachers, university students or individuals whose experience is limited to online tutoring.



We want professional educators who understand how teenagers learn, how to plan effective lessons, how to assess student writing and how to explicitly teach challenging English concepts.



You should be confident teaching students aged approximately 13–16 and comfortable working with international families.



### Essential Qualifications



Applicants must meet ALL of the following requirements:



- Hold a Bachelor's degree in Secondary Education, majoring in English, or an equivalent recognised secondary English teaching qualification.

- Hold a valid Philippine Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) teaching licence, or an equivalent recognised professional teaching credential.

- Have at least two years of actual secondary/high school English classroom teaching experience.

- Have experience teaching literature, reading comprehension, analytical writing and essay composition.

- Demonstrate excellent spoken and written English.

- Understand lesson planning, curriculum expectations, assessment and differentiated instruction.

- Be confident teaching English to students aged 13–16.

- Be able to provide evidence of teaching qualifications, employment history and professional references.



**Please do not apply if your only experience is ESL tutoring, conversational English teaching or informal tutoring.**



## About The English Lab



Our private English programme provides intensive, individualised English instruction.



Each student receives:



- Three 60-minute private English lessons every week.

- A structured ten-week programme.

- Thirty individual teaching sessions.

- A dedicated, qualified English teacher.

- Personalised learning goals and targeted instruction.

- Regular assessment, written feedback and progress reporting.



Students remain with the same teacher throughout their programme to ensure continuity and meaningful academic support.



## Your Responsibilities



As an English Lab teacher, you will:



- Plan and deliver high-quality, individualised English lessons via Google Meet.

- Explicitly teach literary analysis, essay writing, reading comprehension and analytical thinking.

- Assess students' existing skills and identify gaps in understanding.

- Model effective writing and thinking strategies.

- Provide guided and independent practice.

- Assess written work and provide actionable feedback.

- Adapt teaching to individual students' learning needs.

- Maintain accurate lesson records and monitor academic progress.

- Prepare weekly parent progress updates using our templates.

- Communicate professionally with our programme coordinator.

- Maintain consistent teaching availability throughout each ten-week programme.



## Teaching Specialisations



We are recruiting teachers with particular strengths in one or more of these areas.



**1. Secondary English Writing & Composition**



Supporting reluctant writers, teaching sentence and paragraph construction, developing written responses and building writing confidence.



**2. Literature & Literary Analysis**



Teaching students how to interpret literature, analyse language techniques, evaluate evidence and construct meaningful analytical responses.



**3. Academic Writing & Essay Development**



Teaching structured essays, extended analytical responses, argument development, sophisticated written expression and critical thinking.



## Experience With Diverse Learners



Many families who work with The Classic High School Teacher have teenagers who experience difficulties with writing, attention, executive functioning or learning confidence.



Experience teaching students with ADHD, autism, dyslexia or other learning differences is highly desirable.



We value teachers who are patient, encouraging, adaptable and skilled at breaking complex tasks into manageable steps.



## Working Hours



This is a remote, part-time teaching position.



You will teach students from the United States, Australia and potentially Canada.



We are particularly interested in teachers who can offer consistent teaching availability during international after-school hours.



You must be able to commit to the same weekly teaching schedule for a minimum of ten consecutive weeks.



As our programme grows, additional teaching hours may become available.



## What We Provide



- An established international education brand.

- A structured English teaching philosophy and programme framework.

- Access to teaching resources and lesson materials.

- Administrative and student onboarding support.

- Consistent student placements based on availability.

- Opportunities for ongoing teaching contracts.

- A supportive, teacher-led working environment.



## Application Requirements



Please submit the following:



**1. Teaching qualifications**



Your degree, PRC licence details and any additional professional teaching qualifications.



**2. Secondary classroom experience**



The schools where you have taught, year levels taught and number of years of classroom experience.



**3. Teaching specialisation**



Tell us whether your strongest area is writing composition, literary analysis or academic essay writing.



**4. International teaching experience**



Have you taught students following US, Australian, British or other international English curricula?



**5. Your availability**



Provide your preferred teaching days and times in Philippine Time.





**6. A 3–5 minute teaching demonstration video**



Imagine you are teaching a 14-year-old student who can identify a quotation in a novel but struggles to explain its meaning.



Demonstrate how you would teach this student to move from identifying evidence to analysing it.



We are looking for clear explanations, explicit modelling, strong subject knowledge and a warm, professional teaching style.



**7. Your CV and professional references**



Please include your teaching employment history and at least two professional referees.



### Important



To confirm you have read the requirements, begin your application with:



**"I am a qualified secondary English teacher."**



Only applicants who meet our professional teaching qualification and classroom experience requirements will be considered.



We look forward to welcoming exceptional secondary English teachers to The English Lab.



**The Classic High School Teacher**  

*The English Lab*

title: Outbound E-commerce Sales Representative
description:
Job Position: Outbound E-commerce Sales Representative

📈 Thousands of leads per day from post-purchase customers and abandoned checkouts

A performance-driven sales environment focused on checkout recovery, post-purchase sales, and revenue growth.

Sales scripts, product training, and coaching to support your professional development and performance.

The opportunity to contribute directly to sales growth, customer retention, and an excellent customer experience.





Your Role

As an Outbound Sales Representative, you will engage potential and existing customers to recover abandoned checkouts, generate additional sales, and recommend relevant pet care products. You will focus on understanding customer needs, addressing concerns, and identifying opportunities to increase order value while delivering a positive customer experience.

Make outbound calls to customers who have abandoned their checkouts or left their orders incomplete.

Confidently present pet care products and explain their features, benefits, proper use, and value.

Handle objections related to price, product suitability, shipping, trust, and purchase hesitation professionally.

Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and increasing average order value without making irrelevant or excessive product recommendations.

Meet daily and monthly sales targets, conversion goals, call activity expectations, and average order value objectives.

Accurately document call outcomes, customer feedback, objections, purchases, and follow-up actions in the designated systems.

Follow approved sales scripts, standard operating procedures, customer privacy requirements, and escalation guidelines.

Escalate product concerns, order issues, complaints, and other matters outside the scope of sales responsibilities to the appropriate team.

Collaborate with team leaders and management to improve sales techniques, customer engagement, conversion rates, and overall team performance.

Maintain a customer-first approach while consistently working toward revenue growth and sales targets.





Skills & Qualifications



Required Experience

At least more than 3-5 years of experience in outbound sales, telesales, telemarketing, or phone-based B2C sales.

Previous experience selling to customers in the US market is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated ability to close sales over the phone and consistently meet sales targets.

Experience handling objections, following up with leads, and converting potential customers into paying customers.

Experience in e-commerce, direct-to-consumer (DTC), abandoned-checkout recovery, upselling, cross-selling, or repeat-customer sales is a strong advantage.

Experience managing both prospective customers and existing customers is preferred.





Communication & Sales Skills

Advanced spoken English proficiency with clear pronunciation, strong comprehension, and natural conversational ability.

Excellent phone etiquette, active listening, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to build rapport quickly and communicate effectively with US customers.

Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Ability to identify customer needs and recommend appropriate products rather than relying solely on scripted pitches.

Confidence in handling both first-time buyers and existing customers.

Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail when documenting customer interactions.





Pet Knowledge & Product Interest

Genuine interest in pets, particularly dogs and cats.

Familiarity with pet care needs.

Ability to learn product features, benefits, proper use, and limitations and explain them accurately to customers.

Previous experience in the pet industry or selling pet care products is a strong advantage.





Performance & Work Habits

Ability to meet daily and monthly sales targets, conversion goals, productivity metrics, and other assigned KPIs.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Resilience when handling rejection, objections, and difficult conversations.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining accountability.

Willingness to receive coaching, participate in call evaluations, and continuously improve sales performance.

Ability to follow established workflows, maintain accurate customer records, and escalate concerns appropriately.

Ability to balance sales performance with a positive, professional, and customer-focused approach.





Technical Requirements

Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-work environment.

A reliable computer, headset, and quiet workspace & back up power station.

Familiarity with CRM systems, e-commerce platforms, and cloud-based calling tools.

Experience with Shopify, Aircall, Consio, Gorgias, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Willingness to learn the company's sales systems, product catalog, and operating procedures.





Work Schedule

Must be able to maintain consistent attendance and reliable availability throughout the scheduled shift.

I run Sale Signature Homes with Copper Creek Real Estate in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. I'm looking for an experienced cold caller / appointment setter to generate qualified seller leads and set listing appointments for me, a licensed real estate agent.



The job:



- Call homeowners considering selling in the Oklahoma City metro — FSBO, expired listings, and other qualified seller prospects

- Qualify motivation, timeline, and decision-maker status

- Set confirmed listing appointments for me to present a listing strategy

- Follow up with prospects and keep clean notes in the CRM

- Appointment setting and follow-up ONLY — no negotiating price, terms, or commission with sellers

- This is a listings role for a licensed agent. This is NOT an investor / wholesaler / cash-offer acquisitions role, and there is no pivot to distressed sellers



Tools you'll use:

GoHighLevel, LandVoice, and Mojo Dialer. Experience with all three is strongly preferred.



You will have a real list to work: LandVoice + MLS back-catalog of FSBO/expired leads, plus fresh leads each week.



Pay — please read before applying:

I am not starting hourly, due to cashflow. This is performance-based pay:



- I pay at your hourly rate for approved hours, paid when a deal closes from an appointment you set

- Capped at $1,000 per closing

- Hours are approved in advance, tracked, and reset after each closing

- If no closing comes from your appointments, there is no pay

1. Dates you worked for your last two real estate agents, why those roles ended, and whether I can contact them as references

title: online marketing and first-line support for a growing set of apps and web tools
description:
I'm an independent developer in the Netherlands. I build and run a small family of apps and online tools, and I'm looking for one reliable VA to help people find them, for the long term.



What you'll promote



You start with two products that are launching now:



- A Mac app that shows people where their disk space goes and what a cleanup really frees. It launches on 1 December, with a Black Friday offer this week.

- An online short link service with link-in-bio pages and QR codes, for creators and businesses who share links on social media. 



These two come first, are ready to go and have Black Friday deals ready. That's why I need someone who can start as soon as possible, ideally this week.



After that, the job grows. I have more online tools to promote, for example a tool for musicians that finds piano and guitar chords and a few small web tools, with more to come. You'll get to know each one before you promote it.



What you'll do



- Community marketing: find conversations on Reddit, forums, LinkedIn and other platforms where people have the problem one of our products solves, and answer them genuinely helpfully, mentioning the product only when it really fits.

- Social media: write and schedule posts (LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, etc) from material I provide.

- Research and outreach: find communities, blogs, newsletters and creators that fit each product, check their rules, write personal pitch
s, and follow up.

- Directory listings: submit the products to software and app directories.

- First-line support: answer simple customer
s using our help pages, and pass anything technical, billing-related or tricky to me. There's very little of this at first; it grows with the products.



How we work



- Everything happens in our task system. Each task has clear written instructions. You log your work, links and time there, so there are no separate reports to write.

- Honesty is non-negotiable. You always disclose that you work with the developer. You never write fake reviews, never create fake accounts to praise our products, and never manipulate votes or ratings.

- You use your own logins and a work
 address I provide.

- Flexible hours, any time zone. 3 to 5 hours a day, whenever suits you. A regular daily rhythm helps, so customers and I know when to expect replies.



You are



- Fluent in written English, with a friendly, clear and natural writing style.

- Comfortable on Reddit, LinkedIn, 
 and the like. An established Reddit account is a plus, but not required: you're welcome to create a new account for this work.

- Careful with details and good at following written guidelines.

- Patient and polite with customers.

- Curious about technology. Experience with a Mac is a plus.



Pay and start



Start: as soon as possible, ideally this week. Long-term work, with more hours as more products are added. Weekly payments via EasyPay (https://www.onlinejobs.ph/easypay)



How to apply



I read every application myself, so I want to see that you read this whole post. Your application must contain:



1. A subject line or first line in this exact form: "VA application: [your first name], [your time zone]".

2. Three short answers in your own words:

   - Which two products will you work on first, and why do they come first?

   - Name the three things this post says you will never do.

   - Where do you log your work, and why does that mean you don't write reports?

3. A sample reply (under 100 words) to this question, written as you would on Reddit: "My Mac says 'System Data' is using 120 GB. What is it and can I delete it?" Don't mention any app.

4. Links to your LinkedIn profile, and to your Reddit profile if you have one.

5. Your available hours and your time zone.



Applications that skip any of these points won't be considered.



Next steps



- Shortlisted applicants are invited for a video interview (about 20 minutes).

- After that, a short paid trial task (about 2 hours).

- Then I choose, and we start right away.



Hope to hear from you soon!



Cheers,



Bjørn

title: Virtual Assistant (App Developer / Content Creator / Graphic Designer)
description:
Job Description: Content Creator & App Builder

About the Brand

We are a personal brand and real estate business built around a real story: a single mom of three boys breaking into the real estate world, and building a referral business for coaches and athletes who are moving and relocating. The founder has a strong personal brand, a clear vision, and a growing audience. We are growing fast and we need one exceptional person to own the content side and build our community app.

Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, X 
, [others] Content style: Lifestyle, real estate journey, relocation and referral content, family life Stage: Active and growing. This is a brand with direction and momentum, not a startup still feeling its way.

The Role

The founder provides the raw material: photos, videos, and real-life moments. You build the vision from there.

This means owning the content calendar, coming up with post ideas, editing and designing to completion, writing captions, choosing music, researching hashtags, publishing, and tracking performance. You will also build our app, manage our contacts, and be the first friendly voice our clients hear. You bring the creative direction. You flag what you need before it becomes a problem. You work ahead, not behind.

This is not a task-execution role. We are not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. We need a creative strategist and builder who takes raw assets and turns them into a content plan, then sees it through to posting without hand-holding.

First priority: the app. Your first job is to design and build our app, based on our GroupMe chat and our website. Content creation, contacts, and client experience start alongside it, but the app comes first.

Urgent: This is an urgent hire. We need the app successfully completed, with all review comments cleared, by Friday, November 27, 2026 at close of business EST. You are paid hourly for all your work, plus a $40 bonus for successful completion by the deadline.

Big goal: brand deals. We want to secure brand deals, and your content, views, and outreach are how we get there. Your pay grows with the results you deliver.

Hours: 20- 30 hours per week, with flexibility to work more during busier periods. Availability: Flexible on the hours that the VA works independently, however, this person must be available for calls / meetings / feedback, as needed, between 10am-12pm EST  Rate: Starting at $5.00 per hour + Incentive-based compensation: On top of your hourly rate, you earn incentive-based compensation for completing the app on time, securing brand deals, content that goes viral, and views. The more results you deliver, the more you earn. Tools: You provide your own tools. Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, and standard scheduling platforms is expected. Start: Immediate. This is an urgent hire.

What You Will Do

1. App Build (First Priority)

•      Design and build our app first, using our GroupMe chat and our website as the foundation.

•      Study the GroupMe chat: how members communicate, the topics and questions that come up most, the shared resources, and how the group is organized. Use this to d
 the app's features, such as group chats or channels, announcements, a resource library, and a member directory.

•      Review our website: its branding, colors, pages, wording, and offerings. Bring these into the app so the website and app look and feel like one brand.

•      Help move our GroupMe members into the app with a clear, friendly invite and sign-up process.

•      Research the Ladies Playbook app for feature ideas and create a feature list of what we want, confirmed with the founder before building.

•      Build on a no-code or low-code platform (such as Glide, Softr, Bubble, or Adalo), recommending the best one for our budget and goals.

•      Set up core features such as sign-up and login, member profiles, a directory or listings, categories, search, and notifications.

•      Create original branding, layout, wording, and content. We want the same type of experience, not a copy of another company's name, logo, text, images, or code.

•      Test on iPhone and Android, fix bugs, prepare for launch, and maintain and update the app afterward.

2. Content Strategy and Calendar Ownership

•      Build the monthly content calendar from scratch, informed by what is trending, what aligns with our three content pillars, and what will perform on each platform.

•      Plan 3 posts per week, scheduled during each platform's peak engagement hours, and confirm those hours using platform analytics.

•      Rotate through the three pillars, roughly one of each per week:

a.     Real estate journey: behind-the-scenes moments, wins, lessons learned, and day-in-the-life posts.

b.     Referral business for coaches and athletes: relocation tips, success stories, and clear calls to action for referrals.

c.      Family lifestyle: authentic content showing life as a single mom of three boys, balancing family and business.

•      Bring ideas proactively. Do not wait to be asked.

•      Flag asset needs clearly and in advance, never at the last minute.

3. Content Creation and Editing

•      Take the photos and videos provided by the founder and produce polished, on-brand content: Reels, carousels, static posts, stories, and TikToks.

•      Write captions and scripts in the founder's voice, with hooks that stop the scroll and calls to action that convert. Select music and research hashtags.

•      Submit the full month's content (posts, captions, and tweets) for approval by [date each month, such as the 25th] for the following month. Nothing is posted until it is approved.

•      Deliver on time, every time. Fast turnaround is non-negotiable.

4. Publishing, Engagement and Performance

•      Publish and schedule content across all platforms.

•      Tweet daily from our X 
) 
 short posts, thoughts, tips, and conversation starters that follow our three content pillars and match the founder's voice. Draft each month's tweets in advance and include them in the monthly approval.

•      Engage on X every day: reply to followers, join relevant conversations, and share our Instagram and TikTok content and the app. Reactive or real-time tweets only follow agreed guidelines or approval.

•      Respond to comments, DMs, and mentions within [24 hours], and flag anything urgent or sensitive.

•      Monitor post performance and report back every week on followers, reach, engagement, and app sign-ups. Flag what is working and what is not, and recommend next steps.

•      Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm updates, and trending audio.

5. Contacts and Client Experience

•      Transfer all existing contacts into one organized database or CRM, clean and edit records, remove duplicates, and tag contacts by category (clients, members, leads, partners). Keep the database current and backed up.

•      Be the first point of contact for new leads and referrals from social media, the app, and DMs, responding within [24 hours] in a warm, professional tone that matches our brand.

•      Welcome new clients with a friendly onboarding message and clear next steps, including coaches and athletes who are relocating.

•      Track each client's stage (new lead, in contact, working together, closed) and follow up at key points: after first contact, during the move or home search, and after closing with a thank-you and a request for a review or referral.

•      Collect client feedback and testimonials (with permission) and turn them into content.

•      Pass anything involving contracts, pricing, or legal or financial matters straight to the founder.

6. Brand Deals and Partnerships

•      Research brands that fit our audience, such as relocation, moving, home, lifestyle, family, and athletic and coaching brands.

•      Draft pitches to moving companies, with a focus on securing promo codes for our community and business partnerships that benefit both sides.

•      Build a media kit and pitch deck with our audience numbers, views, and best content examples.

•      Write outreach messages, send them, follow up, and track every opportunity, promo code, and partnership in a simple pipeline.

•      Set up and manage our presence on UGC and creator platforms where brands look for creators.

•      Create and publish sponsored content once a deal is secured, and report on its results.

•      Pass pricing, contracts, and final deal terms to the founder for approval.

7. Website Updates (Wix)

•      Update and maintain our website on Wix: edit pages, text, images, and links, and keep everything current.

•      Keep the website consistent with the app and our social media in branding, wording, and offers.

•      Add links to the app and to our Instagram, TikTok, and X 
 pages, with clear calls to action for sign-ups and referrals.

•      Add new content as approved, such as testimonials, referral information, and updates about the app.

•      Check that the site works well on mobile, loads quickly, and has no broken links, and apply basic SEO best practices.

•      Make changes with the founder's approval. The Wix account stays under the founder's ownership, with access provided to you.

8. Automated
 Promotion and Re-Engagement (Wix)

•      Set up automated
 campaigns in Wix to promote the new app, such as a launch announcement, a welcome series for new sign-ups, and follow-up reminders.

•      Set up automated
s to our existing contacts to bring engagement back up, such as check-ins, updates, reminders to join the app, and a follow-up series for contacts who have gone quiet.

•      Segment contacts by category (clients, members, leads, partners) and by activity so each message fits the person receiving it.

•      Write the
s in the founder's voice, with clear calls to action and links to join the app.

•      Organize our
 lists from the contact database, following
 rules (permission and an unsubscribe link in every
).

•      Include partner promo codes and offers in
s once they are secured.

•      Submit
s for the founder's approval before they go out.

•      Track opens, clicks, replies, and app sign-ups, and report on what is working and which contacts are re-engaging.

What We Need From You

REQUIRED: Proactive ownership. You do not wait to be told. You bring ideas, flag problems before they happen, and keep the work moving without being nudged. If you need reminders to do your job, this is not the right fit.

REQUIRED: Content strategy and creation experience. You have built content calendars and created content for real brands, and you have a portfolio that proves it. No portfolio, no consideration.

REQUIRED: App-building experience. You have built apps or websites with no-code or low-code tools, and you can share samples.

REQUIRED: Wix experience. You have built or updated websites on Wix and can share examples.

REQUIRED: Caption and script writing in someone else's voice. You write captions and scripts that sound like the creator, not like a template. You can share examples.

REQUIRED: Availability. You must be reachable for calls and meetings during [time window and time zone]. If you cannot commit to this, do not apply.

REQUIRED: This role is your priority. Other client commitments must not interfere with the quality, timeliness, or attention you bring to this role. If you are stretched across multiple clients, this is not the right fit.

•      Attention to detail: you catch inconsistencies before they become problems.

•      Organized and communicative: you tell the founder exactly what you need and when, well in advance. You never go quiet.

•      Open to feedback: you receive direction, implement it the first time, and do not repeat the same mistake.

•      Trend awareness: you know what audio and formats are trending before they peak.

•      Client care: you are warm, professional, and reliable with people, and you keep private information private.

•      Nice to have: real estate, relocation, or sports and coaching marketing experience; Apple App Store and Google Play submission experience; basic photography or videography skills; CRM and
 marketing experience.

title: US Senior Tax Associate
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

*Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

*Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.
