- Assist with client intake, onboarding, scheduling, and day-to-day firm operations.

- Bring practical ideas for improving templates, workflows, and the client experience.

- Work with tools including Alt Legal, Clio, Dubsado, GoHighLevel, Zoom, and Loom.

What we’re looking for

- Prior legal work experience is required. Experience supporting trademark matters is a plus.

- Strong written English and the ability to draft clear, professional client correspondence.

- Close attention to detail, especially with client names, dates, deadlines, and documents.

- Confidence to ask questions, flag concerns early, and recommend a next step.

- A proactive, business-minded approach and an interest in improving how a small law firm operates.

- Reliable follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities remotely.

Time tracking

Time Doctor is required for this role. You’ll manually start and stop the timer when working on High Tide Legal assignments. Time Doctor captures screenshots during tracked work sessions. If you’re uncomfortable using Time Doctor with screenshots during work sessions, we kindly ask that you do not apply.

How to apply

Use HTL Legal Assistant | Your Full Name as your application subject line, replacing “Your Full Name” with your name. Attach your résumé as a PDF named FirstName_LastName_Resume.pdf.



In your message, briefly describe your legal experience, any trademark work you’ve supported, and which of the tools listed above you’ve used. Share one example of a time you took initiative or improved a process. Include your earliest available start date and confirm that you’re comfortable using Time Doctor with screenshots during tracked work sessions.

Short application exercise

You’re preparing a follow-up
 to a client named Maya Rivera. The matter calendar shows December 10 as the deadline, but the attorney’s intake notes say December 12. Maya also hasn’t sent the product photos we requested.

 to Maya asking for the photos. Label the two parts Attorney note and Client
.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
## —About us—



Battling Monsters is the program of Just Care More and primarily follows the stories of Sandra and Jamie: wingsuit BASE jumping, paragliding and alpine climbing, filmed as honest stories about fear, risk and getting back up. We reach about 560,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram,
 and TikTok, with two YouTube videos a month and daily short-form content. Behind the channel is Just Care More, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that uses those stories to reach people who are fighting their own monsters, through its content and impact campaigns in prisons, rehab centres, group homes and schools.



We are a small team and we are growing it: you would be the first hire, followed by a long-form editor whom you will brief and coordinate.



## —The role—



You run our four social networks end to end: strategy, calendar, short-form editing, publishing, community and reporting, and you are the keeper of our footage archive. You are the single point of contact for the channel day to day, so that the founders can focus on filming, partnerships and the nonprofit's impact work. You edit the reels and shorts yourself; a long-form editor cuts the YouTube videos from your briefs. 



## —What you will do—



**Strategy and growth**



- Own and maintain our social media strategy, with a platform-specific plan for Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube: how each one grows followers, reach and engagement, and how it sends viewers to YouTube.

- Keep brand guidelines for social media and make sure the voice and messaging are consistent on every platform and support the wider mission: inspiring people facing adversity towards self improvement using adventure sports & adventure travel.

- Research successful accounts, competitor posts, trending topics, sounds and formats, and turn what works into posts and videos of our own.



**Ideas and content development**



- Keep an idea bank of about 100 ideas a month across our reel types (short sport, montage, our story, behind the scenes, motivational, campaign related, YouTube promotional), long form videos and carousels and pick the top potential options for the calendar.

- Mine our content library for content worth developing into videos and posts. You will know the footage better than anyone, because you categorize it (see below).

- Write the hooks and concepts for short-form videos.

- Develop every youtube video: title, thumbnail concept, hook and logline, with A/B/C thumbnail and title tests. Sign off the editor's storyboard before the cut.

- Long-form videos must reach 40% average retention. You own the assets (i.e cover, title), the storyboard sign-off and the feedback loop with the editor that gets them there.

- Give the founders a shoot list each cycle if needed: what the calendar needs filmed, interviews for youtube videos, and which backstories are missing for posts.



**Calendar, production and briefs**



- Build the monthly content calendar in Notion together with the founders: fill it from the idea bank plus executive team must-post items and campaign specific posts, and move each piece from idea to posted. The founders approve the calendar monthly.

- Coordinate the production and posting of two long-form videos a month, about 30 short-form videos a month, daily stories and two weekly photo carousels.

- Keep the production calendar scheduled at least 14 days ahead of today at all times.

- Brief the long-form editor for every YouTube video on the calendar, and specify the platform-specific versions each piece needs.

- Write all copy: captions for every post, titles, descriptions, CTAs, hashtags, in the brand voice.

- Choose the audio for every reel: trending, royalty-free or none. Before anything is scheduled, check that the music choice will not trigger a copyright claim.



**Short-form editing**



- Edit the roughly 30 reels and shorts a month yourself, preferably in DaVinci Resolve, from the content library and incoming footage: hook text on screen, captions, audio, pacing to the hook.

- Story graphics, carousel and photo-post layouts



**Content library and categorizing**



- Own the categorizing and classification of all our content: the existing archive of more than 30 TB and every incoming drop from shoots, so that every clip is described, rated and findable.

- Review and approve the AI categorizing proposals, keep the Content Library current, and flag footage gaps to the founders.

- Know the archive well enough to answer "do we have a shot of X" from memory most of the time.



**Publishing**



- Schedule and publish everything on all four networks through Metricool at our set posting times (7:00 AM and 9:00 AM California time) or the best time per network where the data says otherwise.

- Make sure every post type follows our per-network SOPs (reels, stories, albums, YouTube uploads,
 link posts each have one) for format, tags, links, CTAs and posting rules.

- Daily stories with the right tags, links and CTAs with high engagers saved to Instagram highlights

- YouTube housekeeping: tags, cards, end screens, chapters, playlists.



**Community**



- Reply to comments and DMs on all four networks in our voice, pin strategic comments, moderate spam and hate.

- Count and report the "impact messages" we receive each cycle and pass them to the founders and the PR team. That number is one of our two most important goals to measure impact.

- Escalate important conversations to the founders, and spot people with stories of adversity and transformation who could become part of the wider mission and future podcast. Community management here is more than replying to comments.

- Flag collaboration opportunities that show up in the audience. For example recent followers/subscribers with stories that align with our brand



**Reporting**



- Monitor the analytics and KPIs of all four networks continuously, and call out top-performing and underperforming content as it happens.

- Feed high-performing content back into the idea bank each cycle, scaled up a format: a story that did well becomes a reel, a reel or a day with unusually high engagement becomes a candidate long-form video or topic.

- One short report per 10-day cycle, per network: growth against our 2% target, views, watch time and retention, CTR, saves and shares, impact messages.

- Weekly KPI call with Sandra; feed retention and hook data back to the editors.



**Team**



- Brief and coordinate the long-form editor, plus any occasional freelancers.



## —What we are looking for—



- You have run a multi-network calendar for one brand or creator, ideally in outdoor, adventure or action sports.

- You have managed people and tasks before: freelancers, editors or a small team, with deadlines you were accountable for. You will manage the long-form editor, outsourced thumbnail design and other freelancers as the team grows.

- You write hooks and captions that sound like a person, not a brand.

- You edit short-form video confidently and fast, and can show reels you cut yourself. DaVinci Resolve preferred; if you work in Premiere or CapCut you must be willing to switch.

- You are methodical with large media libraries: naming, metadata, ratings, folder discipline. You will be responsible for more than 30 TB of footage.

- You are fluent in Metricool (or a close equivalent), Google Drive, YouTube Studio and the native platforms of Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube.

- You have hands-on experience working in Notion: databases, calendars, templates and briefs, not just notes. Our content calendar and SOPs live there.

- You are organized enough to run a 10-day cycle without being chased, and honest enough to tell us when something is not working.

- You are comfortable with the themes of our content: real risk, fear, injury and recovery, mental health, and the nonprofit's work with people in prisons and rehab.

- English at native or near-native level.

- You can publish during the California morning posting window, and you can work with founders who travel and are sometimes offline for days.

- You own an iPhone and a MacBook (needed to access the social network accounts and our tools) and have reliable internet of at least 30 Mbps.

- You are familiar with AI tools for content creation and social media management, and use them in your day-to-day work.



**Bonus skills**



- Using Davinci Resolve for editing

- Deeper AI experience: building automations for content and social media work.



If you have either, say so in your application and tell us how you have used them.



## —Terms—



- Independent contractor, remote, anywhere in the world.

- approximately 40 hours a week; compensation set monthly salary with monthly bonuses based on performance

- Paid trial task for shortlisted candidates (see below), then a 30-day trial period.

- Start date: start of December 2026, so that your first full cycle runs before the end of the year.



## —How to apply—



1. Links to two accounts or channels you have managed, and your roles and responsibilities with these channels and any accomplishments

2. Links to three reels or shorts you edited yourself, and which software you used.

3. Why you think you are the best fit for this job position

4. What is the biggest suggestion to improve youtube performance of videos and increase views? 

5. Your monthly rate and your location.

6. Confirmation that you have an iPhone, a MacBook and at least 30 Mbps internet, plus any long-form editing or AI experience you want us to know about.



## —Our process—



1. Applications reviewed as they arrive; shortlisted candidates invited to a 30-minute call (late November).

2. you will receive a Paid trial task 

3. Decision and contract first week of December

4. Onboarding and your first supervised cycle in December.

title: YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager
description:
About Us:

Lemuria Citi is a personal brand focused on relationships, intimacy, emotional awareness, self-discovery, and personal growth.



Our content is educational, conversational, thought-provoking, and occasionally playful or provocative. We create meaningful conversations that encourage curiosity, connection, and personal growth.



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager to help us produce engaging, high-quality content for YouTube and Instagram.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity for someone who can combine excellent video editing skills with creativity, organization, and an understanding of social media growth.



Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

- Edit approximately 1 long-form YouTube video per week (typically 8–20 minutes).

- Repurpose long-form videos into approximately 2 engaging YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels per week.

- Create compelling hooks, clean captions, intentional B-roll, tasteful graphics, and on-screen text.

- Maintain professional audio, color, pacing, and overall production quality.

- Design eye-catching, on-brand YouTube thumbnails and Instagram Reel covers.



YouTube & Instagram Management:

- Write compelling, SEO-optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, and chapters.

- Prepare Instagram captions and relevant hashtags.

- Organize content using a shared content calendar.

- Schedule and publish approved content.

- Monitor basic performance metrics and recommend improvements.

- Help identify opportunities to improve audience engagement, retention, and discoverability.



Creative Collaboration:

- Work directly with our Content Manager, who will provide creative direction and final approval.

- Suggest creative ways to make educational talking-head videos more visually engaging.

- Maintain consistent branding across YouTube and Instagram.

- Manage assigned tasks independently and meet agreed deadlines.



Our Editing Style:

This is extremely important to us.



We are NOT looking for overly flashy editing, constant zoom effects, random stock footage, excessive transitions, or generic AI-generated visuals.



We want someone who can create content that feels:

- Polished, elevated, and professional

- Natural, authentic, and conversational

- Visually interesting without being distracting

- Thoughtful, creative, and intentional

- Modern, clean, and appealing to both men and women



Our videos are primarily educational talking-head content. Your creativity should enhance the message, not overpower it.



We value editors who understand storytelling, pacing, and when to let a powerful message speak for itself.



Qualifications:

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos and short-form content.

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software.

- Experience creating high-quality YouTube thumbnails and social media graphics.

- Understanding of YouTube SEO, audience retention, and content optimization.

- Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Instagram, and Meta Business Suite.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, stay organized, and communicate consistently.

- Comfortable working with educational content discussing relationships, intimacy, sexuality, and personal development.



Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Gling, CapCut, or AI-assisted editing tools is a plus.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited, preferably educational, talking-head, or storytelling content.

3. Links to 2–3 YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels you've edited.

4. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you've designed.

5. Your experience managing YouTube and/or Instagram accounts.

6. Your preferred editing software and typical workflow.

7. Your expected hourly rate within our advertised range.



**Please also answer these three questions:**



1. How would you make a 15-minute educational talking-head video more engaging without relying on excessive effects or random B-roll?



2. Describe your process for turning one long-form YouTube video into two compelling Shorts or Reels.



3. Have you managed YouTube or Instagram accounts beyond editing? If so, what responsibilities did you handle, and what results can you share?



We are looking for someone who genuinely understands content creation, not simply someone who can cut and assemble footage.



If you're a creative editor who values storytelling, quality, and thoughtful collaboration, we'd love to see your work!

title: VIDEO EDITOR – ONLINE WEBINARS (talking head + slides) & Educational Videos
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

AccrediPro University produces educational webinars and course videos for health professionals every month. We are looking for one/two editors for a long-term collaboration.



THE WORK

Webinars of 60–80 minutes, recorded as short clips by a host and two experts. You put them together with the slides, following our step-by-step guide: what goes on screen is already written down for every clip.



WHAT WE EXPECT

Clean cuts: only the scripted lines, with no false starts, repeated takes or long pauses.

Clear, even audio for every speaker.

Slides and speakers exactly as the guide says, with slide elements appearing in time with the voice.

A simple, professional result: no music, effects, filters, subtitles or watermarks.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Look at the example folder: 
/drive/folders/1rGUHiAJxlw0MIlKCQWBOcjiSJEJ1BFQV

It holds the first 10 of the 80 slides of one webinar (about 7 minutes), with the clips and our guide, so you can see what the work involves. Do not edit it before we confirm your test.



2. Reply starting with the word "SLIDES" and send us:

Links to 2–3 original videos you edited yourself, ideally with speakers and slides;

The software and equipment you use

Whether, after seeing the example, you can deliver this work at a professional level.

Applications without the word "SLIDES" or without these details are not considered.



TERMS

If we accept your application, we confirm the test in writing: you edit the first 10 slides of the example folder as a finished video, paid $5. If the test is not accepted, you still receive the $5 and the selection ends.



Good test: we sign an agreement, have a short call to show you all the pending work, and commission the full webinar.



From the second webinar on, every job (webinars and educational videos) has a fixed fee agreed in advance, plus a final bonus. There is new work every month, plus a large backlog.



The test is paid only after our written confirmation. OnlineJobs rules do not allow us to ask for free samples, even short ones. 

If you do the test on your own initiative without our go-ahead, the responsibility is yours.



Payment is made by a US company through Wise. You need a Wise account with USD account details, and you must give us the full name on the account, the account number and the routing number. Accounts in Philippine pesos only are not accepted.



This ad stays up while the positions are open.

title: Social Media and Content Manager
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems.



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the short-form content engine of established, fast-growing **founder-led brands**. You’ll work closely with Founders and client teams to turn raw talking-head videos, b-roll, voice notes, event footage, and brand assets into high-performing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms. Your work will directly help founder-led brands grow visibility, attract leads, increase audience engagement, and position themselves as trusted leaders in their industries through sharp, brand-aligned, platform-native content.





***Role Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Editing & Content Packaging

- Transform raw talking-head and b-roll footage into engaging short-form videos with strong hooks, tight pacing, clean cuts, captions, and visual emphasis.

- Edit platform-native videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other short-form content channels.

- Create multiple short-form formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, educational videos, founder-brand reels, and promotional clips.

- Apply strong editing judgment around rhythm, music, transitions, pattern interrupts, zooms, framing, captions, and retention-focused pacing.

- QA all videos before submission or publication to ensure clean captions, strong audio, correct formatting, brand alignment, and high-quality exports.



Graphic Design & Carousel Content

- Design branded graphics, carousel posts, quote cards, reel covers, and promotional visuals aligned with each client’s brand guidelines.

- Turn key ideas, frameworks, quotes, and educational concepts into simple, visually strong carousel content.

- Create clean caption-overlay graphics and visual assets that support short-form video and social media campaigns.

- Maintain consistency across typography, colors, layout, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall brand style.

- Ensure every graphic or carousel feels polished, platform-native, and aligned with the founder-led brand’s voice and positioning.



Content Creation & Management

- Use AI to research trends, winning content references, viral short-form formats, competitor content, and creative angles.

- Review raw content assets to identify strong hooks, clips, moments, b-roll sequences, and short-form content opportunities.

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across social platforms.

- Organize content assets, including raw footage, b-roll, edited videos, brand photos, graphics, captions, references, and creative briefs.

- Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to generate first-draft hooks, captions, content angles, and short-form video ideas.



Social Media Engagement & Audience Management

-- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions across social platforms.

- Help maintain an active, consistent, and professional brand presence for founder-led brands.

- Support audience growth by identifying relevant online communities, ICP profiles, warm connections, and engagement opportunities.

- Set up and manage simple ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Track engagement patterns and audience feedback to identify what content is resonating and where improvements can be made.



Tracking & Reporting

- Generate regular reports on content performance, audience growth, engagement, and short-form video results.

- Track key metrics such as views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- Identify which hooks, formats, topics, editing styles, and visuals are performing best.

- Provide clear insights and recommendations to improve future content performance.

- Use AI to make reporting, performance analysis, and repeatable content workflows faster and more efficient.



Role Requirements:

- - Minimum 3 years of virtual work experience in social media management, content management, or short-form video editing.

- Strong short-form video editing portfolio, especially for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and founder-led personal brands.

- Proven ability to transform raw talking-head footage, b-roll, event clips, and long-form recordings into polished, engaging, high-performing short-form videos.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, captions, sound design, b-roll usage, visual hierarchy, storytelling, and platform-native editing styles.

- Ability to create multiple content formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, carousel posts, educational videos, and promotional clips.

- Proficient in tools such as CapCut, Descript, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, Figma, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Opus, or similar.

- Excellent English, strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving skills, creative judgment, visual taste, and the ability to work independently with founder-led brands.



Role Results (KPIs)

title: Social Media and Content Manager
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems.

Be the driving force behind the short-form content engine of established, fast-growing **founder-led brands**. You’ll work closely with Founders and client teams to turn raw talking-head videos, b-roll, voice notes, event footage, and brand assets into high-performing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms. Your work will directly help founder-led brands grow visibility, attract leads, increase audience engagement, and position themselves as trusted leaders in their industries through sharp, brand-aligned, platform-native content.

Short-Form Video Editing & Content Packaging

- Edit platform-native videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other short-form content channels.

- Apply strong editing judgment around rhythm, music, transitions, pattern interrupts, zooms, framing, captions, and retention-focused pacing.

- QA all videos before submission or publication to ensure clean captions, strong audio, correct formatting, brand alignment, and high-quality exports.



Graphic Design & Carousel Content

- Design branded graphics, carousel posts, quote cards, reel covers, and promotional visuals aligned with each client’s brand guidelines.

- Turn key ideas, frameworks, quotes, and educational concepts into simple, visually strong carousel content.

- Create clean caption-overlay graphics and visual assets that support short-form video and social media campaigns.

- Maintain consistency across typography, colors, layout, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall brand style.

- Ensure every graphic or carousel feels polished, platform-native, and aligned with the founder-led brand’s voice and positioning.



Content Creation & Management

- Use AI to research trends, winning content references, viral short-form formats, competitor content, and creative angles.

- Review raw content assets to identify strong hooks, clips, moments, b-roll sequences, and short-form content opportunities.

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across social platforms.

- Organize content assets, including raw footage, b-roll, edited videos, brand photos, graphics, captions, references, and creative briefs.

- Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to generate first-draft hooks, captions, content angles, and short-form video ideas.



Social Media Engagement & Audience Management

-- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions across social platforms.

- Help maintain an active, consistent, and professional brand presence for founder-led brands.

- Support audience growth by identifying relevant online communities, ICP profiles, warm connections, and engagement opportunities.

- Set up and manage simple ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Track engagement patterns and audience feedback to identify what content is resonating and where improvements can be made.



Tracking & Reporting

- Generate regular reports on content performance, audience growth, engagement, and short-form video results.

- Track key metrics such as views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- Identify which hooks, formats, topics, editing styles, and visuals are performing best.

- Provide clear insights and recommendations to improve future content performance.

- Use AI to make reporting, performance analysis, and repeatable content workflows faster and more efficient.



Role Requirements:

- - Minimum 3 years of virtual work experience in social media management, content management, or short-form video editing.

- Strong short-form video editing portfolio, especially for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and founder-led personal brands.

- Proven ability to transform raw talking-head footage, b-roll, event clips, and long-form recordings into polished, engaging, high-performing short-form videos.

title: Senior Construction Scheduler & Project Controls Lead (Wunderbuild Expert)
description:
READ FIRST: WUNDERBUILD EXPERTS ONLY. NO EXCEPTIONS.



You must be an expert Wunderbuild user today, with project schedules you personally built and ran in it. Experience with MS Project, Primavera, Procore, Buildertrend or any other software does NOT qualify. If you have not personally built schedules in Wunderbuild, do not apply.



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | US Residential Remodeling

Compensation: $9–$15 USD/hour depending on experience; higher for exceptional candidates





ROLE OVERVIEW

Craftsman Collective is a design-build remodeling company in Austin, Texas, specializing in midcentury modern homes. We self-perform much of our work with our own crew, alongside trusted subcontractors, and run several projects at once.



We are moving our project management to Wunderbuild and need an expert to lead that transition. You will own our project schedules, company-wide schedule, material quotes, purchase orders and material tracking in Wunderbuild. You will set the system up the right way and train our team to use it. We are not training anyone on Wunderbuild: you must be ready to contribute on day one and teach the rest of us.



Your job is to keep crews, subcontractors and materials moving together, so our Project Manager can make decisions instead of doing administration. You propose dates, lock them in, and hold people to them. Given a scope and a trade list, you build a draft schedule without waiting to be asked.



This role is open to a senior project controls lead or a highly experienced project coordinator.





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Scheduling

• Build and maintain logic-linked schedules for every project in Wunderbuild: tasks, dependencies, inspections and milestones.

• Draft new project schedules and propose start dates for Project Manager approval.

• Track daily progress against the schedule using video reports, written site reports and timesheets.

• Update schedules as conditions change, and flag delays and critical-path risks the day you see them.

• Maintain a company-wide schedule showing where our crew and subcontractors are each week, and spot conflicts.

• Schedule and confirm subcontractors, and set up Wunderbuild's automated reminders and confirmations.



Material Quotes, Purchase Orders & Tracking

• Build procurement milestones into every schedule: selections due, quotes, approvals, order dates, lead times and delivery dates.

• Get material quotes from suppliers and coordinate pricing to finalize purchase orders. (Our estimator handles subcontract bidding.)

• Submit material selections and pricing to the Project Manager for approval before any order is placed. We quote builder-grade materials, so any upgrade must be priced and approved first. No approval, no order.

• Create and track purchase orders from quote through delivery.

• Maintain a material tracking log for each project: what is quoted, approved, ordered, shipped and delivered, and what is still outstanding.

• Confirm delivery dates with suppliers and keep them matched to the schedule.

• Flag long-lead items and late orders before they hold up work.

• Help build and enforce our standard process for material quotes, approvals, purchase orders and ordering.



Wunderbuild Transition & Training

• Lead our move to Wunderbuild: set up project templates, task libraries, users, permissions, notifications and automations.

• Move our active projects into Wunderbuild and keep the data clean and consistent.

• Train our Project Manager, superintendent, crew leads and office staff, and write simple how-to guides.

• Serve as our in-house Wunderbuild expert and find ways to automate more of our work.



Meetings & Reporting

• Host weekly lookahead meetings covering 3-week, 6-week and 12-week horizons, and record decisions and owners.

• Send a weekly status summary of schedule risks, procurement risks, open decisions and follow-ups.

• Prepare schedule updates and proposed start dates for the Project Manager.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

You own the schedule and material procurement process, not the scope or the budget. Estimating, subcontract bidding and change orders are handled by our estimator. The Project Manager approves schedule baselines, purchases, pricing and scope changes, and the superintendent runs the field. No material order is placed without Project Manager approval. This is not a client-facing role: all communication with homeowners goes through the Project Manager.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Expert Wunderbuild user, with schedules you personally built and ran in it (non-negotiable)

• Able to set up Wunderbuild for a company and train others to use it

• 5+ years in construction scheduling, project coordination or project controls

• Proven ability to build logic-linked schedules: dependencies, lags, critical path and lookaheads

• Experience getting supplier quotes, creating and tracking purchase orders, and tracking material deliveries against a schedule

• Strong understanding of residential building sequence: demolition, framing, rough-ins, inspections, drywall, cabinetry and finishes

• Excellent written and spoken English; confident running video meetings and training sessions

• Proactive and firm: you push for dates, follow up without being asked, and escalate early

• Reliable high-speed internet with backup power



Nice to have: Any exposure to US residential construction (codes, inspections, trade terms), and experience leading a scheduling or project coordination team.





WORKING ARRANGEMENT

• Full-time, 40 hours/week, remote

• Must be able to work US Central Time hours

• Hours logged against the individual projects you support from personal computer

• Reports to the Project Manager





HOW TO APPLY



Apply with your resume and short answers to these questions:

1. Which companies have you used Wunderbuild for, and for how long?

2. About how many project schedules have you built in Wunderbuild, and what types of projects were they?

3. Have you set up Wunderbuild for a company or trained others to use it? Briefly describe what you did.

4. Walk us through how you take a material order from supplier quote to approval, purchase order and delivery.

5. What is your expected hourly rate?

title: Account Manager (Clipping Campaigns)
description:
About Elnez

Elnez is a performance-based UGC and content distribution platform. We turn long-form content into high-impact short-form clips and distribute them across TikTok, Reels, Shorts and X to reach millions of viewers and drive measurable results for creators and brands.



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Account Manager to oversee the execution of clipping campaigns and manage relationships with both clients and participating clippers.



This role sits at the center of campaign operations, requiring someone who can take a campaign from client onboarding through execution and delivery. You will work closely with clients to understand their objectives, translate campaign requirements into actionable briefs, and ensure campaigns are adequately staffed with qualified and active clippers.



A key part of the position involves sourcing and recruiting clippers, building relationships within clipping communities, and maintaining the level of participation needed to keep campaigns running effectively. You will also be responsible for monitoring campaign activity, tracking performance, resolving operational challenges, and keeping clients informed of progress.



The ideal candidate understands the clipping ecosystem, is comfortable with outbound recruitment and relationship management, and can take ownership of multiple campaigns while ensuring that both client expectations and campaign objectives are met.



Key Responsibilities

Manage client accounts and oversee the full lifecycle of clipping campaigns, from onboarding and campaign setup to execution, optimization, and completion.



Work with clients to understand campaign objectives, content requirements, budgets, and expected outcomes, translating these into clear campaign briefs and execution plans.



Source, recruit, and onboard clippers through direct outreach, social media, 
 communities, referrals, and other relevant channels to build a reliable network of campaign participants.



Coordinate campaign launches, communicate briefs and requirements to participating clippers, and ensure they have the necessary information and resources to execute campaigns effectively.



Maintain active relationships with clippers, facilitate communication, address questions and participation issues, and encourage consistent campaign involvement.



Monitor campaign activity, including clip submissions, publishing frequency, views, engagement, and other relevant performance metrics, ensuring campaigns remain on track.



Identify gaps in campaign participation or performance and take appropriate action, whether through additional clipper recruitment, improved communication, or adjustments to campaign execution.



Keep clients informed through regular updates and performance reports, communicating campaign progress, results, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.



Coordinate with internal teams responsible for content review, submission verification, and reward processing to ensure smooth campaign delivery.



Maintain accurate records of campaign activity, clipper participation, client requirements, and performance results.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign outcomes, strengthen client relationships, and encourage repeat business.

Requirements



2+ years of experience in account management, campaign management, creator marketing, influencer marketing, or a related field.



Understanding of clipping campaigns, creator distribution, and social media content ecosystems.

Experience with creator, influencer, or clipper recruitment, including prospecting and outbound outreach.



Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and other short-form content distribution platforms.

Experience managing client relationships and coordinating campaign execution.



Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients and creator communities.



Ability to interpret campaign performance data and use insights to improve execution.



Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Familiarity with 
, spreadsheets, project management tools, and campaign tracking platforms.



Compensation

1. Base Compensation: Initial base compensation: $200/month.

After 90 days, base compensation increases to up to $600/month, depending on the Net Revenue Retention (NRR) performance of assigned client campaigns.



2. Performance-Based Compensation

In addition to the monthly base compensation, Account Managers earn a percentage of the campaign budget actually spent on clipper payouts each month.



This is the primary earning component of the role and has no fixed earnings cap.

5% commission: On qualifying campaign budgets spent and paid out to clippers.

5% commission: Applies to campaign budgets exceeding $30,000, subject to the company's commission calculation policy.

Performance commissions are paid after the corresponding campaign budget has been fully spent.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means being able to independently manage assigned client accounts, ensure campaigns are properly staffed with active clippers, maintain consistent campaign execution, and deliver measurable results.



You should be capable of building the clipper network required to support campaigns, keeping participants engaged, identifying and resolving execution challenges, and maintaining client confidence through effective communication and reliable delivery.



Please apply only if you have prior experience managing campaigns and are comfortable with the compensation structure outlined above.

Our campaigns run from $3,000 to $10,000+.

We focus on data-driven content performance, creative optimization and streamlined workflows. If you're passionate about short-form content, social media growth and the creator economy, you'll fit in here.

The Role

Manage high volumes of outbound and inbound Instagram DMs to start conversations with brands, creators and partners.

Qualify prospects and book discovery calls with the right ones.

Keep the CRM accurate: every conversation, lead status and call outcome logged.

Report on your pipeline and results, and refine your messaging based on feedback and data.

Work with sales, marketing and operations to keep messaging aligned.

Compensation

Commission-only, uncapped.

12% commission on every campaign you close (3,000–9,999).

15% commission on campaigns of $10,000 and above.

5% commission on repeat campaigns from brands you closed, for 6 months after the first deal.

Commission is paid on cash collected, after the client's payment clears.

Commission is reversed if a client refunds or charges back within 30 days.

What that looks like: a $3,000 campaign pays $360. A $10,000 campaign pays $1,500. Closing 12 campaigns a month at a $5,000 average earns $7,200; 20 campaigns earns $12,000+, before repeat business.

KPIs & Expectations

Full target: 6-12 closed campaigns per month.

Month one: 3-6 closed campaigns (50% of the full target) by day 30. This is the bar to continue in the role.

Hit agreed show-rate and close-rate targets once ramped.

Submit an end-of-day report every working day.

Record every sales call.

Keep the CRM up to date in real time.

Attend the weekly sales team meeting.

Report to the Director.

Requirements

A proven closing track record. Be ready to share your close rate, cash collected and average deal size.

Call recordings or references from previous closing or setting roles.

Experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting and closing high-ticket offers.

Experience managing social media DMs at volume.

An Instagram account with 600+ followers and a clean, optimized profile that looks authentic.

Strong written and spoken English: clear, concise and professional.

Comfortable following structured scripts and workflows while adapting to each prospect.

Comfortable with CRM and tracking tools.

Highly organized, detail-oriented and reliable.

Available during campaign windows and able to respond promptly.

Strong advantage: experience selling to brands, agencies or marketing services, or familiarity with clipping, UGC, the creator economy or digital marketing.

Who Wins in This Role

Self-driven and comfortable with commission-only pay.

Coachable: takes feedback and applies it the same week.

Competitive and numbers-focused.

Professional, respectful and committed to non-discriminatory practices with diverse audiences and colleagues.

Onboarding & Support

We invest in getting you to target fast.

Days 1–3: Onboarding materials: our ideal client profile, campaign offers and pricing, sales script, FAQ and objection guide, and recordings of closed deals.

Days 4–5: Shadow live sales calls.

Week 2: Start taking your own calls.

First 30 days: A daily 30-minute one-on-one for call review, role-play and coaching.

Hiring Process

Group interview with shortlisted candidates.

One-on-one interview, including a mock call using the script we send you in advance.

Offer.

title: Outbound Caller / Appointment Setter (Virtual Assistant) | Home Services Industry
description:
This is a fully remote position.



We are a company in the window cleaning and home services industry, and we are looking for a highly dependable, confident, and professional Virtual Assistant to handle outbound calling and estimate booking on behalf of our business.



This is a phone-first role. Your primary responsibility is to call potential residential and commercial customers, introduce our services, build genuine interest, and successfully schedule estimate appointments. If you are someone who thrives on conversations, enjoys connecting with people, and takes pride in turning a cold call into a booked appointment, we want to hear from you.





ABOUT THE ROLE



You will be making outbound calls to prospects and representing our business in a friendly, professional, and persuasive manner. This is not a passive role. We are looking for someone who can carry a conversation naturally, handle objections confidently, and consistently deliver results in the form of booked estimates.



The schedule follows Central Daytime hours in the United States.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make outbound calls to residential and commercial prospects on a daily basis

- Introduce the company and its window cleaning services in a clear, engaging, and professional manner

- Guide conversations confidently toward scheduling estimate appointments

- Book estimate appointments according to customer availability

- Handle objections and common questions from potential customers in a calm and professional way

- Follow the provided calling script while keeping conversations natural and personalized

- Maintain accurate and organized records of all calls, interested prospects, booked estimates, and required follow-ups

- Conduct follow-up calls with prospects who did not book on the first contact

- Provide regular updates on calling activity, results, and any notable customer feedback

- Communicate proactively with the team without needing constant supervision or prompting





QUALIFICATIONS



- Excellent spoken English with a clear, natural-sounding voice and minimal accent that does not interfere with customer understanding

- Strong phone presence with confident, professional, and personable communication skills

- Proven ability to book appointments through outbound calling, not simply making calls or reading a script

- Previous experience in outbound calling, telemarketing, lead generation, or appointment setting is required

- Experience booking appointments for home services, cleaning companies, or similar local service businesses is a strong advantage

- Familiarity with CRM systems and call-tracking tools is preferred

- Experience handling objections and speaking with US-based customers is a significant plus

- Excellent attendance and punctuality with a strong track record of dependability and consistency

- Ability to work independently, manage daily calling targets, and follow up without constant oversight

- Open to feedback and committed to improving performance over time

- Must have a quiet, professional, distraction-free workspace

- Must have a quality noise-canceling headset with a clear microphone (this is non-negotiable)

- Must have a stable, reliable internet connection with a backup option available in case of outages





IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are confident and comfortable initiating conversations with people you have never spoken with before. You are friendly, persuasive, and customer-focused. You show up consistently, take ownership of your results, and understand that the goal is booked qualified estimates, not simply a high call count. You are organized, detail-oriented, and responsive, and you do not need to be micromanaged to stay on track.





HOW TO APPLY



- Include your updated resume

- Include an introduction audio recording (Vacaroo is perfectly fine)



We look forward to hearing from you.

You don't need automotive experience or a "creative strategist" title. If you can write copy that stops cold traffic and gets people to act, and you understand why people buy, you already have the skill that matters. I'll train you on the industry, the accounts and our systems.

Copy & Creative

- Write video ad scripts, hooks and angles at volume. This is the core of the job

- Write filming briefs and shot lists that tell clients exactly what to film

- Plan ads from existing client footage when nothing new needs filming

- Create static ads when we need to move fast and don't have footage

- Iterate on winners with new hooks, angles and formats



Research

- Deep target market research for each client (reviews, Reddit, forums,
 groups, Meta Ad Library)

- Turn ads on and off based on performance

- Propose budget changes to me with your reasoning

- Turn what you learn into the next round of tests and report weekly

- Once you're comfortable, step into a client success manager role for your accounts

- Be the main point of contact for your clients: regular check-ins, results updates and what we're testing next

- Brief clients on what to film, collect footage and keep their creative pipeline full

Content for UpScaler HQ

- Write organic content scripts for me (Instagram, TikTok,
)

Requirements

- Excellent written English, with a natural, conversational tone for Australian business owners. No corporate fluff

- Proven direct response copy for cold traffic, ideally Meta ads (samples required)

- Strong grasp of buyer psychology: pain, desire, objections, open loops, hooks

title: AI CRO Specialist
description:
JWEAR STUDIO | AI CRO SPECIALIST



###ROLE & EXPERTISE###



Act as a Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist with 15+ years of experience in Shopify, DTC e-commerce, women's shapewear, lingerie, activewear, and fashion.



You combine the expertise of:



- Senior CRO Strategist

- Shopify Plus Developer

- UX/UI Conversion Designer

- E-commerce Growth Strategist

- Consumer Psychology Specialist

- SEO & Product Page Optimization Expert

- Mobile Commerce Specialist

- Customer Journey Analyst

-
 & Retention Marketing Specialist



Your mission is to identify every major conversion barrier on my website and develop a prioritized, actionable improvement plan.



## 1. BUSINESS INFORMATION



Website: 

Brand: Jwear Studio

Industry: Women's shapewear, lingerie, underwear, and activewear.

Primary market: United States.

Platform: Shopify.

Target audience: Women looking for comfortable, supportive, flattering everyday clothing and shapewear.

Primary objective: Increase conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, and customer trust.



Do not assume you have access to Shopify Analytics, customer behavior, checkout settings, or backend data.



## 2. COMPLETE WEBSITE CRO AUDIT



Visit and analyze my live website.

Inspect the following pages:



- Homepage

- Main navigation and menu

- Collection pages

- Bestselling product pages

- Individual product pages

- Cart and cart drawer

- Checkout, where publicly accessible

- Shipping and return policies

- FAQ and contact pages

- Mobile and desktop layouts



For each page, identify:



1. Conversion barriers.

2. Confusing design elements.

3. Missing trust signals.

4. Unclear messaging.

5. Poor calls to action.

6. Unnecessary friction.

7. Opportunities to increase purchases.



Provide the exact page URL and location of every issue.

Separate verified observations from assumptions and recommendations.



## 3. HOMEPAGE CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION



Evaluate:



- First impression within five seconds.

- Hero banner effectiveness.

- Headline and supporting copy.

- Shop Now buttons.

- Product discovery.

- Bestseller sections.

- Customer reviews.

- Trust badges.

- Shipping information.

- Return guarantees.

- Promotional offers.

- Mobile navigation.

- Visual hierarchy.



Recommend a homepage structure designed to turn paid advertising traffic into customers.



Include suggested copy, section order, and CTA placement.



## 4. PRODUCT PAGE CRO AUDIT



Evaluate every important product page element:



- Product images and videos.

- Product titles.

- Pricing and compare-at pricing.

- Discount presentation.

- Color swatches.

- Size selection.

- Size guides.

- Fit and compression information.

- Product descriptions.

- Benefits versus features.

- Customer reviews.

- Social proof.

- Shipping and delivery information.

- Return policy visibility.

- Add to Cart button.

- Sticky Add to Cart.

- Mobile usability.

- Bundles and quantity discounts.

- Cross-selling and upselling.



Pay special attention to customer objections:



- Will this fit my body?

- Is the sizing accurate?

- Is it comfortable all day?

- Will it roll down?

- Is the fabric breathable?

- How strong is the compression?

- Can I return it?

- When will my order arrive?



Recommend how to address these concerns using clear product information, verified claims, authentic reviews, and effective page design.



## 5. COMPETITOR BENCHMARKING



Research and compare Jwear Studio with:



1. SKIMS

2. Shapellx

3. Popilush

4. FeelinGirl

5. Honeylove



Compare:



- Homepage layout.

- Product page structure.

- Pricing strategy.

- Promotional offers.

- Bundles.

- Product photography.

- Trust signals.

- Customer reviews.

- Shipping policies.

- Returns.

- Mobile shopping experience.

- Conversion-focused features.



Identify which competitor practices Jwear Studio should consider adopting.



Do not recommend copying proprietary designs, brand identities, or unsupported claims.



## 6. WEBSITE SPEED & SHOPIFY APPS



Evaluate publicly measurable website performance.



Focus on:



- Mobile loading speed.

- Largest Contentful Paint.

- Interaction to Next Paint.

- Cumulative Layout Shift.

- Image optimization.

- JavaScript loading.

- Third-party scripts.

- Shopify theme performance.



Identify possible performance issues.



Explain which Shopify apps or scripts might affect performance, but do not claim to know the installed apps without backend access.



Recommend which features should be removed, optimized, or replaced only when supported by evidence.



## 7. CART & CHECKOUT OPTIMIZATION



Analyze the publicly accessible cart and checkout experience.



Review:



- Cart drawer design.

- Checkout progression.

- Shipping cost clarity.

- Discount code experience.

- Payment methods.

- Express checkout options.

- Abandoned cart friction.

- Upsell placement.

- Trust and security messaging.

- Mobile checkout usability.



Identify improvements that can reduce abandonment without introducing unnecessary distractions.



Respect Shopify checkout customization limitations.



## 8. SEO & PRODUCT CONTENT



Review:



- Product titles.

- Meta titles.

- Meta descriptions.

- Collection descriptions.

- Heading structure.

- Internal linking.

- Image alt text.

- Structured data.

- Search intent.

- Duplicate content.



Research relevant keywords for shapewear, bodysuits, underwear, and activewear in the United States.



Recommend SEO improvements that also support conversions.



## 9.
 MARKETING & RETENTION



Create a recommended Klaviyo strategy covering:



- Welcome series.

- Browse abandonment.

- Abandoned cart.

- Abandoned checkout.

- Post-purchase follow-up.

- Product education.

- Cross-selling.

- Win-back campaigns.

- Customer segmentation.



For each flow, recommend timing, message purpose, audience, and performance metrics.



Do not invent existing flow performance.



## 10. CRO PRIORITY SCORING



Score each identified issue using:



- Impact: 1–10

- Confidence: 1–10

- Implementation effort: 1–10



Calculate a priority score using:



Priority = Impact × Confidence ÷ Effort



Clearly explain that these are estimated prioritization scores, not measured revenue effects.



Categorize recommendations into:



P0: Critical conversion barriers.



P1: High-impact quick wins.



P2: Important improvements.



P3: Longer-term experiments.



## 11. REVENUE OPPORTUNITY ANALYSIS



Create a scenario analysis using these example conversion rates:



- 1.0%

- 1.5%

- 2.0%

- 2.5%

- 3.0%

- 4.0%



Show projected orders and revenue for 10,000 monthly sessions.



Use an illustrative average order value of $60 unless actual data is provided.



Explain that these are mathematical scenarios, not guaranteed outcomes or industry benchmarks.



## 12. 30-DAY IMPLEMENTATION PLAN



Develop a practical implementation roadmap.



Week 1: Audit, analytics validation, and critical fixes.



Week 2: Homepage and product page improvements.



Week 3: Cart, checkout, trust, and mobile optimization.



Week 4: Testing, measurement, and iteration.



For each task provide:



- Exact change required.

- Page or Shopify section.

- Expected customer benefit.

- Priority.

- Responsible specialist.

- Estimated implementation time.

- KPI to measure success.



## 13. FINAL DELIVERABLES



Provide the following:



1. Executive CRO audit.

2. Overall CRO score out of 100, clearly labeled as a heuristic assessment.

3. Top 20 conversion barriers.

4. Top 10 quick wins.

5. Competitor comparison.

6. Recommended homepage layout.

7. Recommended product page layout.

8. Mobile optimization checklist.

9. Shopify speed improvement plan.

10. Cart and checkout improvement plan.

11.
 retention strategy.

12. Prioritized 30-day CRO roadmap.

13. Developer-ready implementation instructions.

14. A/B testing hypotheses and success metrics.



## IMPORTANT RULES



Be critical, specific, and evidence-based.



Do not give generic advice.



Do not invent website issues, competitor features, analytics data, or performance scores.



If you cannot access a page, clearly state that limitation.



Use screenshots or precise page references when possible.



Distinguish verified findings from recommendations.



Do not modify the live Shopify store without my explicit approval.



Focus on measurable improvements to conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, and customer experience.



Start by auditing

Base compensation plus commission

Collaborative, in-office team environment



Fast-paced culture focused on execution, accountability, and results

Miami, FL 33133 (Preferred)

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

title: Pricing Analyst (Government Contracts)
description:
THE ROLE

The Pricing Analyst maximizes company profitability by building competitive, compliant pricing based on data analysis, market trends, and service delivery costs. You'll work with Procurement, Operations, Finance, and Leadership to make sure every price is accurate, defensible, and backed by data.



This role is built for someone who already knows security or service-industry pricing in a government contracting environment and needs little to no training.



Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Central Time (US)

Location: Fully remote



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Receive and interpret requests for quotations, solicitations, contracts, and other formats, and translate them into pricing models

- Build and manage pricing requests, proposals, discounts, and commercial offers

- Develop labor-based pricing, including wage rates, fringe benefits, burdens, overhead, and profit

- Provide pricing support to Procurement and Business Development, and communicate rate structures clearly and confidently to stakeholders

- Troubleshoot pricing discrepancies using rate rules and logical analysis

- Update and maintain pricing and cost data and assumptions, including market research and competitor comparisons

- Track pricing performance and identify opportunities to improve margins and win rates

- Coordinate with other departments to validate pricing information

- Make sure pricing practices follow company policy, business guidelines, and contract requirements

- Handle confidential pricing and cost data with discretion



WHAT YOU BRING



Required: Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field (or 4 additional years of directly related experience in place of a degree)

- 3+ years of pricing, costing, or financial analysis experience

- Experience in the security industry or a service-based industry (e.g., security, janitorial, facilities, staffing, or other labor-driven services)

- Government contracting (GovCon) pricing experience, including pricing submitted on federal RFQs/RFPs



Required: GovCon Pricing Skills

- Building fully burdened hourly bill rates from the ground up: base wage, fringe, health & welfare, payroll taxes (FICA, FUTA, SUTA), workers' compensation, insurance, overhead, G&A, and profit

- Pricing to Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determinations, including locating the correct wage determination on 

- Pricing base and option years, including wage escalation

- Pricing labor covered by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA)

- Working knowledge of the FAR as it applies to pricing (e.g., price reasonableness, price realism, lowest-price-technically-acceptable vs. best-value awards)

- Reading a solicitation's pricing instructions and price schedule (CLINs) and completing it accurately



Required: Tools & Skills

- Advanced Excel: complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and multi-scenario pricing models (2+ years)

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, defensible recommendations

- Excellent attention to detail, because pricing errors cost contracts

- Highly collaborative, with strong communication and interpersonal skills

- Ability to work independently with little to no training

- Ability to handle confidential pricing and cost data with discretion

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private home workspace

- Must pass a pre-employment background check



HIGHLY PREFERRED

- Security services pricing specifically (armed/unarmed officer posts, supervisory coverage, post hours)

- GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) pricing experience

- Price-to-win and competitor pricing analysis

- Experience with pricing or market-intelligence tools (e.g., GovWin, HigherGov, ProPricer)

- NCMA certification (CFCM or CPCM)



Interview Note: Finalists will complete a short pricing exercise.



WHY JOIN US

- Competitive salary, based on experience

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday schedule, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST

- A direct impact on contract wins and company profitability at a growing federal contractor



HOW TO APPLY

Please include short answers to these questions in your application:

1. Do you have pricing experience in the security industry or another service-based industry?

2. Have you priced federal government contracts (RFQs, RFPs, task orders)?

3. Have you built fully burdened hourly bill rates using Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determinations?

4. Briefly list the cost elements you include when building a fully burdened hourly rate.

title: PCB Design Engineer
description:
T-Bird Drones is a stealth startup company that is pursuing the development of drone technologies.



An engineer is needed to support the design of printed circuit boards (PCB) and electrical systems on a drone. The ideal candidate brings expertise in PCB layout, power electronics, signal integrity, EMI mitigation, and RF-aware design. It is necessary to ensure robust electrical connectivity under vibration, thermal cycling, and environmental exposure typical of drone operation.



Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field

• Exceptional problem-solving skills

• Design of multi-layer PCBs for flight-critical and payload functions including motor control, power distribution, sensor fusion, and communication interfaces

• Develop schematics and PCB layouts using industry-standard EDA tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or Cadence)

• Perform design rule checks (DRC) and electrical rule checks (ERC) prior to fab release

• Define and manage stackup configurations for impedance control and high-speed signal routing

• Apply EMI best practices throughout PCB layout including ground plane strategy, decoupling, and trace routing to minimize radiated and conducted emissions

• Create and maintain component libraries, footprints, and design templates

• Ability to read and produce professional-quality schematics, PCB fabrication packages, and wiring documentation

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English



Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree in engineering or related field

• BLDC motor system design

• Modeling and simulation



This position is an hourly job with deliverables every month. Successful execution of milestone objectives in monthly deliverables will determine if continued work will be required from the job candidate. The duration of this job can be long term with successful execution of milestones.



This position is fully remote with flexible work times. Occasional meetings in the Central Time Zone will be required.



Pay rate will be based on education, skills, and experience.

 and Instagram) for a US men's health brand. Our best ads are AI stories: cartoon dramas, song dramas and movie-style scenes. In November, they spent over $100K in a single week.

In every format, each character keeps the same face and the same voice from the first shot to the last.

Must-haves

• CapCut or Premiere Pro.

• Clean audio: clear dialogue, every voice at the same level, nothing that hurts the ears.

• Captions that appear exactly when the person speaks, never before.

• Good English: you read the script and you can hear when a line sounds off.

Nice to have

• After Effects or motion design.

How to apply

Start your subject line with SAME VOICE, so we know you read the whole post. Then send:

2.  For each video: what you did (AI generation, editing or both) and the result if you know it (spend, views, CTR).

5.  Your monthly rate in USD.

No portfolio link, no reply.

What happens next

1.  We watch every portfolio and shortlist the best editors.

2.  Each shortlisted editor gets a short test: one AI ad built from our script and raw clips, due in 48 hours.

3.  The best test gets the job.

title: Experienced eBay Listing Specialist - Used OEM Auto Parts | PART-TIME, LONG-TERM
description:
About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based business specializing in used OEM automotive parts sold on eBay.

We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented eBay Listing Specialist to join our team long-term.

We have an established inventory system, prepared listing information, training videos, and detailed SOPs to help you succeed.



We are not looking for someone learning eBay from scratch. We want someone who already understands eBay Seller Hub, can follow instructions accurately, and takes pride in their work.



Important: This is an eBay-only position. We do not cross-list products to other marketplaces. No cross-listing software or applications are required. All listing work is performed directly through eBay Seller Hub.



What You'll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be creating accurate eBay listings using our prepared inventory information.



WE PROVIDE:



Listing titles that are approximately 85% complete.



Product photographs and SKU numbers.



Vehicle year, make, model, and available part information.



Color and condition details.



Pricing information.



Links to example listings for reference.



Description and condition-note templates using Text Blaze.



A prepared master inventory spreadsheet.



YOUR RESONSIBILITIES:



Create eBay listing drafts directly in eBay Seller Hub.

Finalize titles following our formatting standards.

Complete item specifics and relevant compatibility fields using our supplied information and SOPs.

Upload and organize photographs correctly.

Enter accurate SKUs, prices, and condition information.

Flag missing details, inconsistencies, or uncertain fitment instead of guessing.

Track listing progress and complete assigned batches on schedule.

Review your work for accuracy before submitting it.

Our workflow is designed to be efficient. Once fully trained, our target is approximately 5 minutes per standard listing, while maintaining high accuracy.



WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE : 



Our inventory operates on a monthly sourcing and processing cycle.



We currently prepare approximately 120–330 parts per month, depending on sourcing volume.



The primary inventory handoff normally happens around the Wednesday following the first Saturday of each month.



Most listing work is concentrated in the following days, with deadlines agreed upon based on batch size.



This is a part-time, flexible position with variable hours. Some weeks may have little or no work.



We expect approximately 10–30 productive listing hours per month at our target pace, with additional hours possible for training, corrections, and business growth.



We are seeking someone comfortable with this arrangement who can reliably accommodate our monthly batches.





MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS:



At least 1 year of hands-on eBay listing experience.

Strong familiarity with eBay Seller Hub and creating listings directly on eBay.

Experience listing physical products, preferably used inventory.

Excellent attention to detail.

Good written English and communication skills.

Ability to follow detailed SOPs and instructions.

Comfortable working with Google Sheets.

Desktop PC required.

Reliable internet connection.

Ability to meet agreed deadlines and communicate proactively.



Preferred:

Experience listing used automotive or OEM parts.

Knowledge of vehicle compatibility, part numbers, and variations.

Multiple monitors for efficient multitasking.

Previous experience using Text Blaze or similar productivity tools.

Cross-listing experience or software is not required. We sell exclusively through eBay.

Training & Onboarding



We provide:



5 training videos.



4 detailed PDF SOPs.



Live listing demonstrations.



Guided practice with feedback.



A structured mock-listing assessment.



Our onboarding process includes:



Watching us complete 5 listings.



Completing 10 listings with supervision.



Completing 10 listings independently for review.



Completing a batch of 100 mock listings on a secondary account, with quality-control checkpoints.



All approved training and practice work is paid.



We value accuracy, consistency, communication, and the ability to learn from feedback.



Compensation



Starting pay is $5.25 USD per hour, including approved training and listing work.



Performance bonuses may be offered for consistently accurate work, reliability, and strong performance.



We are looking for a long-term team member, with the potential for additional responsibilities and hours as our business grows.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the phrase "OEM Accuracy" so we know you have read the job description.



Answer the following questions:



How many years of experience do you have creating listings directly through eBay Seller Hub? What types of products have you listed?



Have you previously listed used automotive parts? If yes, tell us about your experience with fitment, part numbers, or vehicle compatibility.



Please share 2–3 examples of eBay listings you personally created. Links or screenshots are acceptable.



Do you have a desktop PC? How many monitors do you use? If comfortable, please include a photo of your workstation showing an OK hand sign (👌). Your face does not need to be visible.



Are you comfortable working on recurring monthly batches, with variable hours and agreed deadlines?



What is your expected hourly rate in USD, and when are you available to start?



Practical Demonstration: Please provide a screen recording of yourself creating a mock used automotive part listing directly in eBay Seller Hub. You may choose any automotive part you are familiar with. Photographs are not required. Demonstrate how you would complete the title, item specifics, condition, compatibility (if applicable), and other relevant listing fields. Attempt the listing to the best of your ability, even if you do not have previous automotive parts experience.



Important: This is a demonstration only. Do not publish the mock listing or expose private account information. Please share a link to your screen recording.



Please answer the questions in your own words. We understand that AI tools can be useful, but we prefer genuine, personal responses so we can get to know your actual experience and communication style.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a brief video interview.



We value reliability, honesty, attention to detail, and people who take ownership of their work.



We look forward to hearing from you!

About the Role



BetterYOU Fitness Centre is a growing 24/7 gym in Pakenham, Melbourne, Australia.



We're looking for a confident, organised and results-driven Virtual Assistant to manage our leads, outbound sales calls, membership renewals and member retention.

Your Responsibilities



Sales & Lead Management

- Able to learn scripts, handle objections and achieve KPIs.

- Two monitors, quality headset and reliable internet.

Gym, membership-based business or Australian customer experience is highly regarded.

We want someone who takes ownership, follows systems, delivers results and doesn't need constant supervision.
